# gh-1684: [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)

## Description

### Bug

Pages deploy is red: the "Build landing + web demo" job fails at **Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)** — `build/fa-extension.zip` regressed **TOTAL-1P +230.3%** (35.7MB → 117.9MB first-party; raw 73.3MB → 155.5MB).

Root cause: PR #1631 ("vendor all CDN engines locally") added on-device inference vendor bundles to the extension build — the gate's NEW-entry lines name them exactly:

- `vendor/litert/0.12.1/litertlm_wasm_compat_internal.wasm` (18.8MB) + `litertlm_wasm_internal.wasm` (18.9MB)
- `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-simd-threaded{,.asyncify}.wasm` (12.9MB + 23.6MB)
- `vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs` (6.1MB)

Example failure: run 39116173117, job 117642302659 (Pages on gh-1670). Every Pages run since #1631 merged fails the same way.

### Context (mapped 2026-10-18)

- `fa-extension.zip` is **not** in GH release assets (v1.0.600: CLI bundles + fa-web-spa.zip only) — Pages (fa1.dev/extension/fa-extension.zip) is the ONLY public download channel today, linked from site/index.html (4 places) + site/llms.txt (2 places) as the documented sideload install path. CWS channel is not live yet (#1631 fixed the rejection; vendoring all engines locally was forced by store policy — that's where the +230% comes from, intentional).
- The same zip is size-gated in build-macos.yml against the SAME committed baseline — yet releases v1.0.599/600 went green while Pages is red: the legs diverged (build flags or a skipped gate). Investigate as part of this fix.

### Owner decision (2026-10-18) — direction locked

1. **Move fa-extension.zip to GH Releases** as a release asset; site links switch to `https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip` (update site/index.html ×4 + site/llms.txt ×2 in the same PR). Pages stops carrying/copying the zip (drop the assemble-step copy + the Pages size-gate leg for the zip).
2. **The size gate moves to PR review time** (quality-gates job in ci.yml): build the extension zip (or a fast manifest-only variant) on PRs that touch extension sources/vendor and fail the PR on budget regression — the problem must surface at review, not at deployment.
3. Reseed `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape in the same PR (the vendored engines are intentional — CWS policy).
4. Make the build-macos.yml and (new) PR gates symmetric — one baseline, one enforcement rule; resolve why the release leg was green while Pages was red.
5. Never-again: arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates (their baselines were never committed — they have been notice-only since #1096).

### Acceptance criteria

1. Pages deploys green; the Pages artifact no longer contains fa-extension.zip; the site's extension download links point at the GH release asset.
2. fa-extension.zip is attached to releases (latest tag onward).
3. The extension size gate runs in PR CI (quality-gates) against the reseeded baseline; a vendor-bump PR without a reseed fails red at review time.
4. web-app.tsv + outlook-app.tsv baselines committed and armed, or the legs removed.
5. The macos/PR gate symmetry question answered in the PR description.

### Evidence

- Failing job log: run 39116173117 / job 117642302659, step "Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)", `##[error]size budget regression in build/fa-extension.zip (6 line(s) beyond +5.0%)`.
- Introducing change: #1631 (merged).

blocks.text:
name: Pages

# Builds the Flutter web demo (flutter_app) into site/app and
# deploys the static landing (site/) to GitHub Pages. Pages source must be
# set to "GitHub Actions" in the repo settings.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'site/**'
      - 'blog/**'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'flutter_app/**'
      - 'packages/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'vendor/**'
      - 'browser_ext/**'
      - 'scripts/build_browser_ext.sh'
      - 'office_addin/**'
      - 'scripts/build_office_addin.sh'
      - 'scripts/build_site.dart'
      - 'scripts/site_markdown.dart'
      - '.github/workflows/pages.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# One deploy at a time; queued runs must not be cancelled mid-deploy.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build landing + web demo
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily website watcher's budget arithmetic (#351):
    # flutter web build + extension dart2js + add-in build + a Playwright
    # chromium boot smoke; historically ~15m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # Same pinned SDK as ci.yml web-spa (#1100): fa1.dev and
          # fa-web-spa.zip must never drift onto different Flutter stables.
          # EXACT patch pin (#1431): a wildcard pin re-resolves a new
          # engine build on every 3.47.x patch drop, the canvaskit/skwasm
          # artifacts move under a new rev-hash dir and every size gate on
          # the artifact false-reds. Bump this pin consciously in the same
          # PR that reseeds any floor a real size delta moved.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      # gh-1275 AC3 (web leg): fail fast before the web build — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      - name: Example app pub get
        # gh-1265 AC2: resolve against the committed lockfile.
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # the build fails without it.
      - name: Placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored too (real keys stay local). The
      # web build needs the file to compile: copy the tracked placeholder —
      # main.dart skips Firebase init for YOUR_* values, so the demo runs
      # without Analytics (as it always has).
      - name: Placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: Build web demo
        working-directory: flutter_app
        id: web_build
        run: >-
          flutter build web --release
          --base-href /app/
          --output ../build/pages/app

      # The vendored WASI interpreter assets are mobile-only (#1096 AC3):
      # assets/wasm/* loads exclusively through WasiSandboxShell
      # (env_factory_io.dart — Android/iOS); the web build compiles
      # env_factory_stub (wasm_run needs dart:ffi) and runs python/js/
      # sqlite from cdn.jsdelivr.net (web_interpreters_web.dart). ~47MB
      # of dead weight in the deploy root — prune post-build, flags
      # untouched. The extension/office panel builds prune the same set
      # inside their packaging scripts.
      - name: Prune mobile-only wasm interpreter assets (#1096 AC3)
        run: |
          # Shared prune (scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh): fails loudly on
          # flutter_assets layout drift. assets/wasm (~47MB) is loaded
          # exclusively via WasiSandboxShell (mobile-only); the pub
          # package's own test fixtures (coach_anny.glb, 5.6 MB) ride
          # along as package assets nothing on the web app loads.
          bash scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh build/pages/app/assets \
            assets/wasm packages/js_widget_runtime/test

      # The Chrome extension ships on the site too (download + load
      # unpacked): dart2js the SW agent and zip it — flutter is already on
      # PATH here and the script's --with-app embeds the same web build.
      - name: Build Chrome extension
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get && cd ../..
          bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # The Office add-in ships on the site too (sideload from
      # fa1.dev/outlook/manifest.xml): the script validates the manifest,
      # builds the fa web app with the office host flag (the pane IS the
      # app, outlook/app/) and assembles build/pages/root/outlook/ in
      # place — BEFORE the assemble step, so the artifact dir persists
      # into the upload.
      - name: Build Office add-in
        run: |
          cd office_addin/dart && dart pub get && cd ../..
          bash scripts/build_office_addin.sh

      # gh-1476 (PR #1479 owner directive): the static GEO layer is
      # generated ONLY here, straight into build/pages — the artifacts
      # (blog/docs pages, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) are gitignored
      # deploy-time products and never exist in the repo tree; sources
      # (blog/posts, docs/*.md, site/*.html|txt|css) are the single
      # source of truth. `--out` copies the static tree and overlays the
      # generated layer, so the Assemble step below picks up the freshly
      # built files, not repo paths. Dep-free pure Dart scripts — no
      # `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          # build/pages/root already holds the complete site: the GEO
          # step above built the generated layer AND the static tree
          # into it. Only the deploy-specific additions land here.
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BUILD_ID: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Bust the Flutter demo app's entry scripts so browsers never load a
          # stale flutter_bootstrap.js / helper bundle after a new deploy.
          sed -i -E 's|src="([^\"]+)"|src="\1?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/app/index.html
          # Bust the landing page's own CSS/JS and the demo-app iframe/link.
          sed -i -E 's|href="styles\.css"|href="styles.css?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)

name: Build macOS Release (Fa)

# Issue #343: the daily-publish CLI leg and a human can dispatch this
# workflow in the same window; the run-name embeds the input so the
# watcher's displayTitle match (the only distinguisher in the run-list
# API) never adopts someone else's run.
run-name: "build-macos (create_release=${{ inputs.create_release }})"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version (e.g. v0.0.2) or "auto" to increment patch'
        required: false
        default: 'auto'
      create_release:
        description: 'Create GitHub Release'
        required: false
        default: 'true'
        type: choice
        options:
          - 'true'
          - 'false'

# Release builds are never preempted (issue #194 pt 5, same principle as
# ci.yml: tag/release runs must not be cancelled mid-flight; gh-1537
# retired the post-merge main ci run).
concurrency:
  group: Build macOS Release (Fa)-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

# SEC-08 (#796): minimal default — release-attaching jobs grant
# contents: write in their own job-level blocks.
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  version:
    name: Derive version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Explicit ceiling so the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351)
    # has a real per-job bound instead of GitHub's 360m default. gh-1477:
    # 10m was a time bomb — the full-history fetch outgrew its twin in
    # build-mobile (run 38027695551). 20m + the blobless filter below.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1477: this job reads ONLY `git tag` — a full clone transfers
          # every blob ever written and the repo grows daily, so the fetch
          # outgrew the old 10m ceiling (run 38027695551). Blobless keeps
          # full tag/commit metadata without the blobs.
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - name: Derive build version
        id: version
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          INPUT="${{ inputs.version }}"
          if [ -z "$INPUT" ] || [ "$INPUT" = "auto" ]; then
            LATEST=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1 || echo "")
            if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then
              TAG="v0.0.1"
              echo "No previous tag found — starting at $TAG"
            else
              MAJOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\1/')
              MINOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\2/')
              PATCH=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\3/')
              PATCH=$((PATCH + 1))
              TAG="v${MAJOR}.${MINOR}.${PATCH}"
              echo "Previous tag: $LATEST → auto-increment to $TAG"
            fi
          else
            TAG="$INPUT"
            [[ "$TAG" != v* ]] && TAG="v$TAG"
            echo "Using manual version: $TAG"
          fi
          VERSION_CLEAN="${TAG#v}"
          echo "version=$VERSION_CLEAN" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  build-macos:
    name: Build macOS ${{ matrix.arch }}
    needs: version
    # gh-1600 F-A: pin the ONE self-hosted macOS runner (fa-m5-1) via its
    # unique registration label — the generic [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]
    # list also matched the Linux self-hosted box's labels (same routing
    # bug that sent the build-mobile iOS jobs to Linux, gh-1600).
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macos-m5]
    # Issue #239: TestFlight submit now waits for Apple processing (bounded,
    # default 90 min) + a ~1-min one-shot appearance probe AFTER the
    # build/notarize work (gh-1041: the blocking distribution wait moved to
    # the deferred store-appearance-check workflow) — the job ceiling must
    # cover the worst case, not just the build.
    timeout-minutes: 150
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        arch: [arm64, x86_64]
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      # Workaround: force .NET (used by the runner) to use SocketsHttpHandler
      # instead of Apple's SSL APIs, avoiding "bad certificate format" errors
      # caused by corporate Zscaler/MDM certificates in the system keychain.
      DOTNET_SYSTEM_NET_HTTP_USESOCKETSHTTPHANDLER: "0"

    steps:
      # ── Prepare persistent local git mirrors ────────────────────────────────
      # gh-1644: the old inline single-shot logic died on the first network
      # hiccup — the recreate fell through to a full `git clone --mirror`
      # whose ~1 h transfer ended in "error: 2931 bytes of body are still
      # expected" (run 38855793382, exit 128). The shared script retries the
      # fetch with VISIBLE stderr, aborts stalled attempts, and recreates
      # BLOBLESS (--filter=blob:none, the gh-1477 precedent) with retries and
      # partial-dir cleanup. Contract: scripts/update_git_mirror_selftest.sh
      # gh-1665 review: this step runs BEFORE any checkout on persistent
      # self-hosted runners — the workspace may hold a pre-merge tree (or be
      # wiped), so the script is bootstrapped from the commit-pinned raw URL
      # (workflow_dispatch-only workflows ⇒ ${{ github.sha }} is always a
      # pushed commit) with the mirror copy as the no-network fallback.
      - name: Update local git mirrors
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MIRROR_BASE="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/mirror"
          mkdir -p "$MIRROR_BASE"
          MIRROR="$MIRROR_BASE/flutter_agent_harness.git"
          SCRIPT="$RUNNER_TEMP/update_git_mirror.sh"
          RAW="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/${{ github.sha }}/scripts/update_git_mirror.sh"
          if ! curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 "$RAW" -o "$SCRIPT" \
             || [ ! -s "$SCRIPT" ]; then
            echo "raw bootstrap failed — syncing the mirror and falling back to its copy" >&2
            # gh-1665 review (returned IMPORTANT): in the one-run-wide
            # first-post-merge window the persistent mirror is still a
            # PRE-MERGE tree. Cheap single-shot ensure (bounded resilience
            # stays owned by $SCRIPT below) so the extraction that follows
            # succeeds on any runner that can reach github.com at all —
            # raw.githubusercontent.com being down degrades to the
            # fallback instead of a red leg.
            if [ -d "$MIRROR" ] && git -C "$MIRROR" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              git -C "$MIRROR" fetch origin || true
            else
              rm -rf "$MIRROR"
              git clone --mirror https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git "$MIRROR" || true
            fi
            BRANCH="$(git --git-dir="$MIRROR" symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo main)"
            git --git-dir="$MIRROR" show "$BRANCH:scripts/update_git_mirror.sh" > "$SCRIPT" \
              || { echo "::error::could not bootstrap update_git_mirror.sh (raw URL unreachable and mirror lacks the script)" >&2; exit 1; }
          fi
          bash "$SCRIPT" \
            https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git \
            "$MIRROR"

      # ── Checkout ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      # gh-1600 AC2: hardened mirror-checkout — the bare `rm -rf
      # "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"` used to fail the whole checkout on stale
      # unremovable leftovers in the persistent shared workspace (bench
      # docker leftovers, jobs/fa-2.1-docker-cpu-14/). Log-and-prune clean +
      # clone-around-stub; the per-arch build cache is parked outside the
      # workspace before the clean and restored after the clone (best-effort:
      # a lost cache re-builds from scratch, it never fails the checkout).
      # INLINE (not a composite action) on purpose: local `uses: ./...`
      # actions resolve against $GITHUB_WORKSPACE at step time — on this box
      # that is the PREVIOUS run's tree, and this step IS the checkout.
      - name: Checkout repository from local mirrors
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          MIRROR_BASE="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/mirror"
          MAIN_MIRROR="$MIRROR_BASE/flutter_agent_harness.git"
          ARCH="${{ matrix.arch }}"
          BUILD_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/build-cache/macos-$ARCH"

          echo "HOME=$HOME"
          echo "GITHUB_WORKSPACE=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          echo "MAIN_MIRROR=$MAIN_MIRROR"
          echo "ARCH=$ARCH"

          if [ -d "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/build/macos" ]; then
            echo "Preserving existing macOS build cache for $ARCH..."
            rm -rf "$BUILD_CACHE_DIR"
            mkdir -p "$BUILD_CACHE_DIR"
            mv "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/build/macos" "$BUILD_CACHE_DIR/" \
              || echo "::warning::could not park the $ARCH build cache — it will be rebuilt from scratch (gh-1600)"
          fi

          cd /tmp

          # gh-1600 AC2: tolerate stale unremovable paths in the persistent
          # shared workspace — log-and-prune, never fail the checkout.
          if ! rm -rf "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::warning::$GITHUB_WORKSPACE not fully removable — stale paths held by another process (gh-1600); pruning what is removable"
            rm -rf "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" || true
          fi
          if [ -d "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
            # gh-1600 rework (review thread): best-effort prune of previous
            # sidecars BEFORE creating a new one — the containers that held
            # them may have died since, so the retry often succeeds. On
            # this persistent box the runner's own _temp cleanup cannot
            # remove mount-held content either; without the prune every
            # degraded checkout would leave another timestamped dir behind
            # (unbounded growth until manual cleanup).
            rm -rf "${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}"/stale-workspace-* 2>/dev/null || true
            STALE="${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/stale-workspace-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
            echo "::warning::$GITHUB_WORKSPACE still non-empty after prune — moving the remainder to $STALE (gh-1600)"
            mkdir -p "$(dirname "$STALE")" 2>/dev/null || true
            if ! mv "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" "$STALE" 2>/dev/null; then
              echo "::warning::$GITHUB_WORKSPACE could not be moved aside either — cloning around the stub (gh-1600)"
            fi
          fi
          mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

          CLONE_TARGET="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          if [ -n "$(ls -A "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
            CLONE_TARGET="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE.checkout"
            rm -rf "$CLONE_TARGET"
          fi
          git clone --reference "$MAIN_MIRROR" --depth=1 \
            https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git "$CLONE_TARGET"
          if [ "$CLONE_TARGET" != "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" ]; then
            while IFS= read -r entry; do
              name="$(basename "$entry")"
              if [ -e "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$name" ]; then
                # gh-1600 rework (review thread): fresh content must win —
                # park the stale stub in the same $STALE sidecar and move
                # the fresh entry in. The old path skipped the fresh entry
                # (warning-only) and the trailing rm -rf "$CLONE_TARGET"
                # then DELETED it, silently keeping the stale leftover at
                # that repo path. Skip-with-warning remains only as the
                # last-resort fallback when even parking the stub fails.
                STALE_DIR="${STALE:-${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/stale-workspace-sidecar}"
                if mkdir -p "$STALE_DIR" 2>/dev/null && mv "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$name" "$STALE_DIR/" 2>/dev/null; then
                  mv "$entry" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/"
                else
                  echo "::warning::stub collision on '$name' — left in $CLONE_TARGET (gh-1600)"
                fi
              else
                mv "$entry" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/"
              fi
            done < <(find "$CLONE_TARGET" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1)
            rm -rf "$CLONE_TARGET"
          fi
          echo "Checked out: $(git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" log -1 --oneline)"

          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

          if [ -d "$BUILD_CACHE_DIR/macos" ]; then
            echo "Restoring macOS build cache for $ARCH..."
            rm -rf build/macos 2>/dev/null || true
            mkdir -p build
            mv "$BUILD_CACHE_DIR/macos" build/ \
              || echo "::warning::could not restore the $ARCH build cache — it will be rebuilt from scratch (gh-1600)"
          fi

      # Persistent pinned SDK (issue #354): same rationale as
      # build-mobile.yml — on a persistent self-hosted runner the
      # flutter-action cache costs a ~1GB untar on setup plus a whole-SDK
      # re-tar POST per job. The composite action pins the SDK at
      # ~/actions-runner-yoloit/flutter-sdk (.fah-version marker):
      # subsecond reuse, one download per pin bump, no POST step.
      # Still a pinned 3.47.x install instead of the runner's
      # pre-installed SDK — the candidate-path loop picked up a stale
      # 3.44.4 at ~/.local/flutter, which broke `flutter pub get` the
      # moment the repo floor moved to >=3.47.0 (daily-publish #260/#261).
      - name: Setup Flutter environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-flutter-selfhosted
        with:
          # EXACT patch pin (#1431): this leg builds + gates fa-extension.zip
          # against scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv — a wildcard pin
          # re-resolves a new engine build on every 3.47.x patch and moves
          # the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the gate tracks. Bump
          # consciously, with any floor reseed in the same PR.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'

      - name: Setup host toolchains
        run: |
          echo "/opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
          echo "/opt/homebrew/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
          flutter --version
          dart --version

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: |
          if command -v rustup &> /dev/null; then
            echo "Rust already installed"
            rustup show
          else
            echo "Installing Rust..."
            curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y
            source "$HOME/.cargo/env"
          fi
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
          rustup --version
          cargo --version

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      # The plist is gitignored, so the fresh CI checkout has none and the
      # native Firebase SDK logs I-COR000012/0008 at startup. Inject it from
      # a secret when available (same dev.fa1.app registration as
      # firebase_options.dart).
      - name: Write GoogleService-Info.plist (macOS)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/macos/Runner/GoogleService-Info.plist
            echo "GoogleService-Info.plist written (bundle: $(plutil -extract BUNDLE_ID raw flutter_app/macos/Runner/GoogleService-Info.plist))"
          else
            echo "⚠️ GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64 not set — building without the native Firebase plist"
          fi

      - name: Install Flutter dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Dependency versions
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          echo "=== Dependency versions ==="
          flutter pub deps --style=compact

      # flutter_gemma ≥1.5.5 no longer downloads the Apple LiteRT-LM companion
      # dylibs from its hook (they are bundled via the Podfile phase), so a
      # fresh runner has nothing at ~/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma and the
      # Runner script phase fails with "Could not find macOS companion
      # dylibs". Seed the cache from the upstream native release (pinned,
      # sha256-verified).
      - name: Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion dylibs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma/native/macos_arm64"
          if [ -f "$GEMMA_CACHE/libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.dylib" ]; then
            echo "companion dylibs already cached"
          else
            echo "seeding companion dylibs from flutter_gemma native-v0.16.0"
            mkdir -p "$GEMMA_CACHE"
            # --retry alone skips transient mid-transfer resets (curl 56);
            # --retry-all-errors retries them (sha256 below guards corruption)
            curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
              -o /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz \
              https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.16.0/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz
            echo "c597554a7a5cdf099658227099a54ef4916c5802b9182757e656e1788f9426b6  /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz" | shasum -a 256 -c -
            tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz -C "$GEMMA_CACHE"
          fi
          ls -la "$GEMMA_CACHE"

      # The workspace is re-cloned every run, which wipes Pods/ and forces a
      # full pod install (~4 min with Firebase). Cache it keyed by the
      # lockfile; $HOME-level caches (pub-cache, CocoaPods download cache,
      # Ruby gems, Flutter SDK) already persist on the self-hosted runner.
      - name: Cache CocoaPods (macOS)
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: flutter_app/macos/Pods
          key: macos-pods-${{ hashFiles('flutter_app/macos/Podfile.lock') }}

      - name: Generate build info
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GIT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
          GIT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
          SUBMODULES=$(git submodule status --recursive | tr '\n' ';')

          mkdir -p lib/core/services
          printf '%s\n' \
            '// Generated build info — CI overwrites this file before compilation.' \
            '// ignore_for_file: constant_identifier_names' \
            '' \
            "const String kBuildGitCommit = '${GIT_COMMIT}';" \
            "const String kBuildGitBranch = '${GIT_BRANCH}';" \
            "const String kBuildSubmodules = '${SUBMODULES}';" \
            > lib/core/services/build_info.dart

          echo "Build info generated:"
          cat lib/core/services/build_info.dart

      - name: Cache vendored WasmRun macOS framework
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Frameworks/WasmRun.xcframework
          key: wasmrun-xcframework-v0.1.0
      - name: Restore vendored WasmRun macOS framework
        timeout-minutes: 15
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The prebuilt XCFramework is excluded from git. Order of preference:
          # 1) actions/cache hit (per-runner, keyed by the release tag) —
          #    every slot is first-run-warm forever;
          # 2) local working copy on this self-hosted runner;
          # 3) upstream release asset — the curl budget MUST fit the 15-min
          #    step cap WITH CORRECT ARITHMETIC (gh-1149): --retry N is N
          #    retries ON TOP OF the initial attempt, so worst case is
          #    (N+1) × max-time + N × retry-delay. 3 × 240s + 2 × 5s + one
          #    30s connect + unzip ≈ 790s < 900s. The old "3 retries × 240s"
          #    math forgot the initial attempt (975s > 900s → the step
          #    timeout fired mid-retry), and without -C - no 240s attempt
          #    could ever deliver the 92.7MB asset at this link's ~300KB/s
          #    (it needs ~309s) — every attempt died at the cap having
          #    restarted from byte 0.
          LOCAL_SRC="/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/flutter_agent/vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Frameworks/WasmRun.xcframework"
          DEST="vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Frameworks"
          mkdir -p "$DEST"
          if [ -f "$DEST/WasmRun.xcframework/Info.plist" ]; then
            echo "Using framework already in place (actions/cache hit or valid leftover)"
          elif [ -d "$LOCAL_SRC" ]; then
            echo "Using local framework: $LOCAL_SRC"
            cp -R "$LOCAL_SRC" "$DEST/"
          else
            echo "No cache, no local copy — downloading from upstream release..."
            # -C - makes each loop attempt RESUME the partial zip (Range
            # requests), so slow links make forward progress; retries live
            # in THIS loop (not curl --retry, which would add extra attempts
            # AND restart+truncate instead of resuming). Budget: 3 × 240s
            # max-time + 2 × 5s sleeps = 730s < the 15-min step cap, leaving
            # connect + unzip + slack (gh-1149).
            # PER-ARCH zip path: both matrix archs run on ONE self-hosted
            # runner (the shared-state race this file already guards with
            # per-arch keychains below) — a shared arch-less /tmp zip would
            # let one job's rm -f unlink the other's in-flight partial, then
            # both curls interleave bytes into one path.
            ZIP="/tmp/WasmRun.xcframework-${{ matrix.arch }}.zip"
            rm -f "$ZIP"
            for attempt in 1 2 3; do
              # --fail: without it curl exits 0 on HTTP 404/5xx and writes
              # the error page into the zip; with it every HTTP error
              # engages this loop's retries and the explicit failure below.
              if curl --fail -L -C - --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 240 \
                -o "$ZIP" \
                https://github.com/juancastillo0/wasm_run/releases/download/wasm_run-v0.1.0/WasmRun.xcframework.zip; then
                break
              fi
              if [ "$attempt" = "3" ]; then
                echo "WasmRun.xcframework download failed after $attempt attempts" >&2
                exit 1
              fi
              echo "download attempt $attempt failed, resuming in 5s..."
              sleep 5
            done
            # The release asset is immutable per tag — pin its digest so a
            # wrong-content-but-valid-zip cannot slip past unzip CRC32 into
            # the permanent wasmrun-xcframework-v0.1.0 cache (same pattern
            # as the litertlm download above).
            echo "aca903d732202bcdf9c8d19fbb8a795c3c930762419f852a5ee228468c548a98  $ZIP" | shasum -a 256 -c -
            unzip -q "$ZIP" -d "$DEST"
          fi
          ls -la "$DEST/WasmRun.xcframework"

      # Per-arch keychain: both matrix archs build on ONE self-hosted
      # runner; a shared build.keychain raced (one job's delete+create
      # emptied it under the other's codesign — errSecInternalComponent /
      # "No certificate found", builds 86).
      - name: Import macOS signing certificate
        id: signing
        env:
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64 }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          MACOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.MACOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "⚠️  No signing certificate found — building unsigned (development only)"
            echo "signed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "✅ Signing certificate found — importing..."
            security delete-keychain build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain 2>/dev/null || true
            security create-keychain -p "$MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security default-keychain -s build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security unlock-keychain -p "$MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security set-keychain-settings -t 3600 -u build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security list-keychains -d user -s build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db

            echo "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64" | base64 --decode > certificate.p12
            security import certificate.p12 -k build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain \
              -P "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD" \
              -T /usr/bin/codesign \
              -T /usr/bin/productbuild
            security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple: -s -k "$MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            echo "signed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

          if [ -n "$MACOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$MACOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > profile.provisionprofile
            echo "profile_embedded=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

            # Make the profile visible to Xcode manual signing.
            PROFILE_UUID=$(security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile | plutil -extract UUID raw -)
            PROFILE_NAME=$(security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile | plutil -extract Name raw -)
            PROFILE_TEAM=$(security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile | plutil -extract TeamIdentifier.0 raw - 2>/dev/null || true)
            echo "Profile: $PROFILE_NAME / UUID: $PROFILE_UUID / team: $PROFILE_TEAM"
            mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning Profiles"
            cp profile.provisionprofile "$HOME/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning Profiles/${PROFILE_UUID}.provisionprofile"
            echo "profile_uuid=$PROFILE_UUID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "profile_team=$PROFILE_TEAM" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "⚠️  No provisioning profile found — TestFlight will warn"
            echo "profile_embedded=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Build macOS release (${{ matrix.arch }})
        env:
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID }}
          PROFILE_UUID: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_uuid }}
          PROFILE_TEAM: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_team }}
        run: |
          ARCH="${{ matrix.arch }}"
          echo "Building for architecture: $ARCH"
          cd flutter_app
          if [ -n "${MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID:-}" ]; then
            export FA_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID"
            export FA_CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual
            if [ -n "${MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID:-}" ]; then
              export FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID"
            elif [ -n "${PROFILE_TEAM:-}" ]; then
              export FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$PROFILE_TEAM"
            fi
            if [ -n "${PROFILE_UUID:-}" ]; then
              export FA_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER="$PROFILE_UUID"
            fi
          else
            export FA_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="-"
            export FA_CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Automatic
          fi
          FLUTTER_XCODE_ARCHS="$ARCH" flutter build macos --release \
            --build-name=$BUILD_VERSION \
            --build-number=$BUILD_NUMBER
          MAIN_BIN=$(find build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app -name "Fa" -type f | head -1)
          echo "=== Binary architecture verification ==="
          echo "Binary path: $MAIN_BIN"
          file "$MAIN_BIN"
          lipo -info "$MAIN_BIN"
          echo "=== End binary verification ==="
          # The Dart side resolves the wasm_run FFI surface via dlsym on the
          # main executable. If the symbols were dead-stripped or not exported
          # the app boots to a white screen on TestFlight — fail here instead.
          echo "=== wasm_run FFI symbol verification ==="
          # dyld_info reads the exports trie, which survives stripping
          # (nm -gD fails on stripped binaries with "no dynamic symbol table").
          EXPORTS=$(xcrun dyld_info -exports "$MAIN_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true)
          WIRE_COUNT=$(echo "$EXPORTS" | grep -c " _wire_" || true)
          echo "wasm_run wire_* exports in binary: $WIRE_COUNT"
          for SYM in _wire_compile_wasm _store_dart_post_cobject _init_frb_dart_api_dl; do
            if ! echo "$EXPORTS" | grep -qE " ${SYM}\$"; then
              echo "::error::$SYM is not exported from the app binary — wasm_run would crash at runtime (white screen)"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "✅ wasm_run FFI symbols are exported"

      - name: Package as DMG
        id: package
        env:
          SIGNED: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.signed }}
          PROFILE_EMBEDDED: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_embedded }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          ARCH="${{ matrix.arch }}"
          APP_PATH="flutter_app/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app"
          DMG_NAME="fa-macos-${ARCH}-${VERSION}.dmg"

          # Size diet (#1096 AC4 + direction 3): drop what no macOS code path
          # can load — before any codesign so the seal covers the shipped
          # tree. Both cuts ride in flutter_assets inside App.framework:
          # 1) assets/wasm (~47 MB) — WASI interpreter modules loaded
          #    exclusively via WasiSandboxShell (env_factory_io.dart routes
          #    desktops to the host Process shell; every rootBundle.load of
          #    assets/wasm lives in the mobile-only shell).
          # 2) packages/js_widget_runtime/test — the pub package's
          #    own test fixture (coach_anny.glb, 5.6 MB); nothing in the app
          #    references that path (the live model, when used, is fetched
          #    by the JS-app catalog, not bundled).
          ASSETS="$APP_PATH/Contents/Frameworks/App.framework/Versions/A/Resources/flutter_assets"
          # Shared prune (scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh — the same call
          # runs on the no-sandbox build and every web packaging surface):
          # fails loudly if the flutter_assets layout drifts instead of
          # silently shipping the fat bundle. Re-enable path (review,
          # #1096): if a desktop WASI/sandbox mode ever ships
          # (WasiSandboxShell on macOS), reseed assets/wasm — until then a
          # desktop wasm load would fail as a missing asset, not a
          # #1224-class "no lazy loader" stub.
          bash scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh "$ASSETS" \
            assets/wasm packages/js_widget_runtime/test

          rm -f fa-macos-*.dmg tmp-fa.dmg
          rm -rf dmg-staging

          echo "Packaging: $APP_PATH → $DMG_NAME (arch: $ARCH)"

          if [ "$SIGNED" = "true" ] && [ -n "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" ]; then
            echo "Signing .app bundle..."

            RESVG_BIN="$APP_PATH/Contents/Resources/resvg"
            if [ -f "$RESVG_BIN" ]; then
              echo "Stripping extended attributes from resvg..."
              xattr -cr "$RESVG_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
              echo "Signing resvg binary..."
              codesign --force --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                "$RESVG_BIN"
            fi

            find "$APP_PATH" -type f \( -perm +111 -o -name '*.dylib' \) | while read -r bin; do
              if codesign -dv "$bin" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID"; then
                continue
              fi
              echo "Signing nested binary: $bin"
              codesign --force --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                "$bin" 2>/dev/null || true
            done

            if [ "$PROFILE_EMBEDDED" = "true" ] && [ -f "profile.provisionprofile" ]; then
              echo "Embedding provisioning profile..."
              cp profile.provisionprofile "$APP_PATH/Contents/embedded.provisionprofile"
              APP_ID=$(security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile | plutil -extract Entitlements xml1 -o - - | grep -A 1 'com.apple.application-identifier' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*<string>\(.*\)<\/string>.*/\1/')
              TEAM_ID="${APP_ID%%.*}"
              # Start from Release.entitlements (network client+server, file
              # bookmarks, calendar, contacts, health, homekit, audio input)
              # and inject the provisioning identity keys — do NOT collapse
              # to a sandbox-only dict: the app needs every entitlement the
              # sandbox declares, and dropping them breaks SSO callback
              # servers, file access, and OS-level permission flows in the
              # signed production build.
              cp flutter_app/macos/Runner/Release.entitlements entitlements.plist
              # PlistBuddy handles dotted top-level key names (plutil
              # -insert/-replace treats dots as nested key separators).
              /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :com.apple.application-identifier string $APP_ID" entitlements.plist
              /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :com.apple.developer.team-identifier string $TEAM_ID" entitlements.plist
              # The profile may not grant every *capability* the app declares
              # (e.g. homekit needs a separate App ID capability in the
              # Developer Portal). TestFlight rejects capability entitlements
              # the profile doesn't include ('Invalid Code Signing
              # Entitlements', error 90285).
              #
              # Only com.apple.developer.* keys are profile-gated. The
              # com.apple.security.* sandbox entitlements (network, files,
              # personal-information) are NOT in the profile by design — any
              # sandboxed app may declare them — so they must survive.
              #
              # NOTE: `plutil -extract ... -o -` (stdout form) is not
              # supported on every macOS the runner may have; use real temp
              # files so the extraction can't silently produce nothing.
              security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile -o profile_decoded.plist
              plutil -extract Entitlements json profile_decoded.plist -o profile_ents.json
              for KEY in $(plutil -convert xml1 entitlements.plist -o - | grep -o '<key>[^<]*</key>' | sed 's/<[^>]*>//g'); do
                case "$KEY" in
                  com.apple.application-identifier|com.apple.developer.team-identifier) continue ;;
                  com.apple.developer.*) ;;
                  *) continue ;; # sandbox + misc entitlements are not profile-gated
                esac
                if ! python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('profile_ents.json')); raise SystemExit(0 if '$KEY' in d else 1)"; then
                  echo "Dropping capability not granted by profile: $KEY"
                  /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Delete :$KEY" entitlements.plist
                fi
              done
              ENTITLEMENTS="entitlements.plist"
            else
              ENTITLEMENTS="flutter_app/macos/Runner/Release.entitlements"
            fi

            codesign_app() {
              codesign --force --deep --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                --entitlements "$ENTITLEMENTS" \
                "$APP_PATH"
            }

            for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
              if codesign_app; then
                break
              fi
              if [ "$attempt" = "5" ]; then
                echo "codesign failed after $attempt attempts"
                exit 1
              fi
              sleep_seconds=$((attempt * 30))
              echo "codesign failed, retrying in ${sleep_seconds}s (attempt $attempt/5)..."
              sleep "$sleep_seconds"
            done

            echo "Verifying code signature..."
            codesign -vv --deep --strict "$APP_PATH"
            spctl -a -vv "$APP_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true
          fi

          DMG_STAGING="dmg-staging"
          rm -rf "$DMG_STAGING"
          mkdir "$DMG_STAGING"
          cp -R "$APP_PATH" "$DMG_STAGING/"
          ln -s /Applications "$DMG_STAGING/Applications"

          TMP_DMG="tmp-fa.dmg"
          hdiutil create \
            -volname "Fa $VERSION" \
            -srcfolder "$DMG_STAGING" \
            -ov \
            -format UDRW \
            "$TMP_DMG"

          hdiutil convert "$TMP_DMG" -format UDZO -o "$DMG_NAME"
          rm -f "$TMP_DMG"
          rm -rf "$DMG_STAGING"

          echo "dmg_name=$DMG_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          ZIP_NAME="fa-macos-${ARCH}-${VERSION}-mac.zip"
          echo "Packaging ZIP for auto-update: $ZIP_NAME"
          ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent "$APP_PATH" "$ZIP_NAME"
          SHA512=$(openssl dgst -sha512 -binary "$ZIP_NAME" | openssl base64 -A)
          SIZE=$(stat -f%z "$ZIP_NAME")
          MANIFEST_ARCH="$ARCH"
          if [ "$MANIFEST_ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then
            MANIFEST_ARCH="x64"
          fi
          MANIFEST_NAME="latest-mac-${MANIFEST_ARCH}.yml"
          RELEASE_DATE=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
          printf '%s\n' \
            "version: ${VERSION}" \
            "files:" \
            "  - url: ${ZIP_NAME}" \
            "    sha512: ${SHA512}" \
            "    size: ${SIZE}" \
            "    arch: ${MANIFEST_ARCH}" \
            "path: ${ZIP_NAME}" \
            "sha512: ${SHA512}" \
            "releaseDate: '${RELEASE_DATE}'" \
            > "$MANIFEST_NAME"
          echo "zip_name=$ZIP_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "manifest_name=$MANIFEST_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "baseline_arch=$MANIFEST_ARCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate on
      # the shipped mac zip (auto-update channel). arm64 baseline is
      # committed, reseeded onto the post-cut shape (#1096 size diet: no
      # wasm_run_flutter.framework, no flutter_assets/assets/wasm, no
      # js_widget_runtime test assets — regrowth of any of those fails as
      # a NEW line > 5% of TOTAL); unknown archs FAIL — never self-seed
      # green.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (mac zip)
        run: |
          case "${{ steps.package.outputs.baseline_arch }}" in
            arm64|x64) ;;
            *) echo "::error::mac arch '${{ steps.package.outputs.baseline_arch }}' has no size baseline mapping — add scripts/size_budget/fa-macos-<arch>.tsv and extend this whitelist" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check "${{ steps.package.outputs.zip_name }}" \
            --baseline "scripts/size_budget/fa-macos-${{ steps.package.outputs.baseline_arch }}.tsv" --init-if-missing

      # A self-seeded baseline (e.g. first x86_64 release) lands only in
      # this job's ephemeral workspace — upload it so it can be fetched
      # and committed to arm that arch's gate (same as pages.yml).
      - name: Upload seeded size baselines (#1096 ratchet)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: size-baselines-macos
          path: scripts/size_budget/*.tsv
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Package TestFlight PKG (arm64)
        if: matrix.arch == 'arm64'
        id: testflight_pkg
        env:
          MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64: ${{ secrets.MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64 }}
          MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_PASSWORD }}
          MACOS_INSTALLER_CERT_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_INSTALLER_CERT_ID }}
          MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Mac Installer Distribution cert not configured — skipping TestFlight PKG (the DMG path is unaffected)."
            exit 0
          fi
          # The installer cert goes into the same build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain (it exists
          # from the signing step when SIGNED=true; create it otherwise).
          KEYCHAIN_PASS="${MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD:-}"
          if ! security list-keychains | grep -q build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain; then
            # create-keychain fails with "already exists" when the keychain
            # exists but is not in the search list (grep above missed it) —
            # tolerate that and just add it to the search list.
            security create-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASS" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain || true
            security default-keychain -s build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASS" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security list-keychains -d user -s build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db
          fi
          echo "$MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64" | base64 --decode > installer.p12
          security import installer.p12 -k build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain \
            -P "$MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_PASSWORD" \
            -T /usr/bin/productbuild -T /usr/bin/xcodebuild
          security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple: -s -k "$KEYCHAIN_PASS" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
          rm -f installer.p12

          APP_PATH="flutter_app/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app"
          PKG_NAME="fa-macos-arm64-${VERSION}.pkg"
          echo "Building TestFlight package: $APP_PATH → $PKG_NAME"
          productbuild --component "$APP_PATH" /Applications "$PKG_NAME" \
            --sign "$MACOS_INSTALLER_CERT_ID"
          echo "pkg_name=$PKG_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Notarize DMG
        if: steps.signing.outputs.signed == 'true'
        env:
          MACOS_NOTARIZE_APPLE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_APPLE_ID }}
          MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID }}
          MACOS_NOTARIZE_APP_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_APP_PASSWORD }}
          DMG_NAME: ${{ steps.package.outputs.dmg_name }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$MACOS_NOTARIZE_APPLE_ID" ]; then
            echo "⚠️  Notarization secrets not set — skipping notarization"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Submitting for notarization..."
          xcrun notarytool submit "$DMG_NAME" \
            --apple-id "$MACOS_NOTARIZE_APPLE_ID" \
            --team-id "$MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID" \
            --password "$MACOS_NOTARIZE_APP_PASSWORD" \
            --wait
          xcrun stapler staple "$DMG_NAME"
          echo "✅ Notarization complete"

      - name: Submit PKG to TestFlight
        if: steps.testflight_pkg.outputs.pkg_name != ''
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          MACOS_PKG_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/${{ steps.testflight_pkg.outputs.pkg_name }}
          # External TestFlight distribution (issue #239): lanes fail
          # loudly when these are unset — set them once as repo variables.
          TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP: ${{ vars.TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP }}
          BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL: ${{ vars.BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL }}
          BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL: ${{ vars.BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL }}
          BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE: ${{ vars.BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE }}
          # gh-1522: the ASC/TestFlight version string rides the derived tag
          # version (store_pubspec_version prefers BUILD_NAME; the committed
          # pubspec is the 0.0.0-dev placeholder).
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::App Store Connect API key not configured — skipping TestFlight upload (the PKG stays in artifacts)."
            exit 0
          fi
          bundle install
          bundle exec fastlane mac submit_only

      - name: Upload TestFlight PKG artifact
        if: steps.testflight_pkg.outputs.pkg_name != ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: fa-macos-testflight-pkg
          path: ${{ steps.testflight_pkg.outputs.pkg_name }}
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Upload macOS artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: Fa-macos-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: |
            ${{ steps.package.outputs.dmg_name }}
            ${{ steps.package.outputs.zip_name }}
            ${{ steps.package.outputs.manifest_name }}
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Build and package no-sandbox release
        id: package_nosandbox
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ARCH: ${{ matrix.arch }}
          FA_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID }}
          PROFILE_UUID: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_uuid }}
          PROFILE_TEAM: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_team }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd flutter_app
          if [ -z "${FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM:-}" ] && [ -n "${PROFILE_TEAM:-}" ]; then
            export FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$PROFILE_TEAM"
          fi
          if [ -n "${PROFILE_UUID:-}" ]; then
            export FA_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER="$PROFILE_UUID"
          fi
          FLUTTER_XCODE_ARCHS="$ARCH" ./scripts/build_macos_nosandbox.sh
          APP_PATH="build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app"
          NO_DMG="fa-macos-nosandbox-${ARCH}-${VERSION}.dmg"
          NO_DMGTMP="tmp-fa-nosandbox.dmg"
          # Same size diet as the sandboxed DMG above (review, #1096): the
          # fresh no-sandbox build carries the full flutter_assets — prune
          # before any packaging so DMG and ZIP both ship lean.
          bash ../scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh \
            "build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app/Contents/Frameworks/App.framework/Versions/A/Resources/flutter_assets" \
            assets/wasm packages/js_widget_runtime/test
          rm -rf dmg-staging-nosandbox
          mkdir dmg-staging-nosandbox
          cp -R "$APP_PATH" dmg-staging-nosandbox/
          ln -s /Applications dmg-staging-nosandbox/Applications
          hdiutil create \
            -volname "Fa $VERSION (no sandbox)" \
            -srcfolder dmg-staging-nosandbox \
            -ov \
            -format UDRW \
            "$NO_DMGTMP"
          hdiutil convert "$NO_DMGTMP" -format UDZO -o "$NO_DMG"
          rm -f "$NO_DMGTMP"
          rm -rf dmg-staging-nosandbox
          NO_ZIP="fa-macos-nosandbox-${ARCH}-${VERSION}-mac.zip"
          ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent "$APP_PATH" "$NO_ZIP"
          echo "dmg_name=$NO_DMG" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "zip_name=$NO_ZIP" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Upload no-sandbox macOS artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: Fa-macos-nosandbox-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: |
            flutter_app/${{ steps.package_nosandbox.outputs.dmg_name }}
            flutter_app/${{ steps.package_nosandbox.outputs.zip_name }}
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Cleanup keychain
        if: always()
        run: |
          security delete-keychain build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain 2>/dev/null || true
          rm -f certificate.p12 installer.p12

  build-macos-cli:
    name: Build macOS CLI ${{ matrix.arch }}
    needs: version
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351): dart
    # CLI bundle + release upload; the two arches run in PARALLEL on
    # GitHub-hosted runners (they do not serialize like the self-hosted
    # build-macos matrix does).
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: macos-latest
            arch: arm64
          - runner: macos-15-intel
            arch: x64
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Build CLI bundle
        run: |
          version="${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}"
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=build/out
          mv build/out/bundle/bin/fah build/out/bundle/bin/fa
          chmod +x build/out/bundle/bin/fa
          echo "$version" > build/out/bundle/version.txt

      - name: Ad-hoc sign CLI binary
        run: |
          codesign --force --sign - build/out/bundle/bin/fa

      - name: Archive and upload CLI bundle
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-macos-${{ matrix.arch }}.tar.gz"
          tar -czf "$asset" -C build/out bundle
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282: one naming scheme, no
          # "Fa " prefixes), latest is explicit.
          if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

# gh-1684: [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)

## Description

### Bug

Pages deploy is red: the "Build landing + web demo" job fails at **Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)** — `build/fa-extension.zip` regressed **TOTAL-1P +230.3%** (35.7MB → 117.9MB first-party; raw 73.3MB → 155.5MB).

Root cause: PR #1631 ("vendor all CDN engines locally") added on-device inference vendor bundles to the extension build — the gate's NEW-entry lines name them exactly:

- `vendor/litert/0.12.1/litertlm_wasm_compat_internal.wasm` (18.8MB) + `litertlm_wasm_internal.wasm` (18.9MB)
- `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-simd-threaded{,.asyncify}.wasm` (12.9MB + 23.6MB)
- `vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs` (6.1MB)

Example failure: run 39116173117, job 117642302659 (Pages on gh-1670). Every Pages run since #1631 merged fails the same way.

### Context (mapped 2026-10-18)

- `fa-extension.zip` is **not** in GH release assets (v1.0.600: CLI bundles + fa-web-spa.zip only) — Pages (fa1.dev/extension/fa-extension.zip) is the ONLY public download channel today, linked from site/index.html (4 places) + site/llms.txt (2 places) as the documented sideload install path. CWS channel is not live yet (#1631 fixed the rejection; vendoring all engines locally was forced by store policy — that's where the +230% comes from, intentional).
- The same zip is size-gated in build-macos.yml against the SAME committed baseline — yet releases v1.0.599/600 went green while Pages is red: the legs diverged (build flags or a skipped gate). Investigate as part of this fix.

### Owner decision (2026-10-18) — direction locked

1. **Move fa-extension.zip to GH Releases** as a release asset; site links switch to `https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip` (update site/index.html ×4 + site/llms.txt ×2 in the same PR). Pages stops carrying/copying the zip (drop the assemble-step copy + the Pages size-gate leg for the zip).
2. **The size gate moves to PR review time** (quality-gates job in ci.yml): build the extension zip (or a fast manifest-only variant) on PRs that touch extension sources/vendor and fail the PR on budget regression — the problem must surface at review, not at deployment.
3. Reseed `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape in the same PR (the vendored engines are intentional — CWS policy).
4. Make the build-macos.yml and (new) PR gates symmetric — one baseline, one enforcement rule; resolve why the release leg was green while Pages was red.
5. Never-again: arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates (their baselines were never committed — they have been notice-only since #1096).

### Acceptance criteria

1. Pages deploys green; the Pages artifact no longer contains fa-extension.zip; the site's extension download links point at the GH release asset.
2. fa-extension.zip is attached to releases (latest tag onward).
3. The extension size gate runs in PR CI (quality-gates) against the reseeded baseline; a vendor-bump PR without a reseed fails red at review time.
4. web-app.tsv + outlook-app.tsv baselines committed and armed, or the legs removed.
5. The macos/PR gate symmetry question answered in the PR description.

### Evidence

- Failing job log: run 39116173117 / job 117642302659, step "Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)", `##[error]size budget regression in build/fa-extension.zip (6 line(s) beyond +5.0%)`.
- Introducing change: #1631 (merged).

name: Pages

# Builds the Flutter web demo (flutter_app) into site/app and
# deploys the static landing (site/) to GitHub Pages. Pages source must be
# set to "GitHub Actions" in the repo settings.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'site/**'
      - 'blog/**'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'flutter_app/**'
      - 'packages/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'vendor/**'
      - 'browser_ext/**'
      - 'scripts/build_browser_ext.sh'
      - 'office_addin/**'
      - 'scripts/build_office_addin.sh'
      - 'scripts/build_site.dart'
      - 'scripts/site_markdown.dart'
      - '.github/workflows/pages.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# One deploy at a time; queued runs must not be cancelled mid-deploy.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build landing + web demo
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily website watcher's budget arithmetic (#351):
    # flutter web build + extension dart2js + add-in build + a Playwright
    # chromium boot smoke; historically ~15m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # Same pinned SDK as ci.yml web-spa (#1100): fa1.dev and
          # fa-web-spa.zip must never drift onto different Flutter stables.
          # EXACT patch pin (#1431): a wildcard pin re-resolves a new
          # engine build on every 3.47.x patch drop, the canvaskit/skwasm
          # artifacts move under a new rev-hash dir and every size gate on
          # the artifact false-reds. Bump this pin consciously in the same
          # PR that reseeds any floor a real size delta moved.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'
          channel: stable

      # gh-1275 AC3 (web leg): fail fast before the web build — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      - name: Example app pub get
        # gh-1265 AC2: resolve against the committed lockfile.
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # the build fails without it.
      - name: Placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored too (real keys stay local). The
      # web build needs the file to compile: copy the tracked placeholder —
      # main.dart skips Firebase init for YOUR_* values, so the demo runs
      # without Analytics (as it always has).
      - name: Placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: Build web demo
        working-directory: flutter_app
        id: web_build
        run: >-
          flutter build web --release
          --base-href /app/
          --output ../build/pages/app

      # The vendored WASI interpreter assets are mobile-only (#1096 AC3):
      # assets/wasm/* loads exclusively through WasiSandboxShell
      # (env_factory_io.dart — Android/iOS); the web build compiles
      # env_factory_stub (wasm_run needs dart:ffi) and runs python/js/
      # sqlite from cdn.jsdelivr.net (web_interpreters_web.dart). ~47MB
      # of dead weight in the deploy root — prune post-build, flags
      # untouched. The extension/office panel builds prune the same set
      # inside their packaging scripts.
      - name: Prune mobile-only wasm interpreter assets (#1096 AC3)
        run: |
          # Shared prune (scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh): fails loudly on
          # flutter_assets layout drift. assets/wasm (~47MB) is loaded
          # exclusively via WasiSandboxShell (mobile-only); the pub
          # package's own test fixtures (coach_anny.glb, 5.6 MB) ride
          # along as package assets nothing on the web app loads.
          bash scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh build/pages/app/assets \
            assets/wasm packages/js_widget_runtime/test

      # The Chrome extension ships on the site too (download + load
      # unpacked): dart2js the SW agent and zip it — flutter is already on
      # PATH here and the script's --with-app embeds the same web build.
      - name: Build Chrome extension
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get && cd ../..
          bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # The Office add-in ships on the site too (sideload from
      # fa1.dev/outlook/manifest.xml): the script validates the manifest,
      # builds the fa web app with the office host flag (the pane IS the
      # app, outlook/app/) and assembles build/pages/root/outlook/ in
      # place — BEFORE the assemble step, so the artifact dir persists
      # into the upload.
      - name: Build Office add-in
        run: |
          cd office_addin/dart && dart pub get && cd ../..
          bash scripts/build_office_addin.sh

      # gh-1476 (PR #1479 owner directive): the static GEO layer is
      # generated ONLY here, straight into build/pages — the artifacts
      # (blog/docs pages, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) are gitignored
      # deploy-time products and never exist in the repo tree; sources
      # (blog/posts, docs/*.md, site/*.html|txt|css) are the single
      # source of truth. `--out` copies the static tree and overlays the
      # generated layer, so the Assemble step below picks up the freshly
      # built files, not repo paths. Dep-free pure Dart scripts — no
      # `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          # build/pages/root already holds the complete site: the GEO
          # step above built the generated layer AND the static tree
          # into it. Only the deploy-specific additions land here.
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BUILD_ID: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Bust the Flutter demo app's entry scripts so browsers never load a
          # stale flutter_bootstrap.js / helper bundle after a new deploy.
          sed -i -E 's|src="([^\"]+)"|src="\1?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/app/index.html
          # Bust the landing page's own CSS/JS and the demo-app iframe/link.
          sed -i -E 's|href="styles\.css"|href="styles.css?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
