changes:
    name: Classify changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips the classifier too — every downstream leg is gated on
    # release-pending and would skip anyway, so classifying would be
    # wasted work (and a skipped classifier with empty outputs would
    # wave every changes-keyed leg past its path gate).
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      core: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.core || steps.filter.outputs.core }}
      app: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.app || steps.filter.outputs.app }}
      docs: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.docs || steps.filter.outputs.docs }}
      shared: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.shared || steps.filter.outputs.shared }}
      # PR-only (issue #303): a trajectory-touching diff flips this on so
      # the perf-gate leg below runs the #262 DoD gate per-merge.
      perf: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.perf }}
      # PR-only (gh-1241 REG-1): a trajectory/session/usage-touching diff
      # runs the usage-fold suite per-merge.
      usagefold: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.usagefold }}
      # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set — live on
      # pull_request events AND on SM validation dispatches: the paths
      # step derives the validated diff from merge-base(origin/main, HEAD)
      # when no pull_request context exists (fail-safe — a classification
      # failure runs the leg, never skips it).
      exzone: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.exzone }}
      # Issue #1267 N2: the diff modified flutter_app/pubspec.lock — the
      # transitive-drift vector that kept linux/windows release builds red
      # for five nights (#1265). Same path-triggered model as exzone.
      locksmoke: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.locksmoke }}
      # PR-only (issue #551): test/integration/** changes run the no-key
      # mock-LLM integration legs per-PR instead of at tag time only.
      intmock: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.intmock }}
      # gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: a diff touching the installer generation
      # pipeline (site/** or scripts/gen_installers.dart) runs the
      # sh-portability legs — template lint, golden drift, and the piped
      # wizard under dash (ubuntu) / bash (macOS).
      installer: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.installer }}
      # gh-1659: the Outlook add-in acceptance suite — same path list the
      # retired standalone office-addin.yml push/PR triggers carried,
      # gated on pull_request + SM validation dispatches like
      # exzone/locksmoke (tags/schedule never ran the suite and skip it).
      office_addin: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.office_addin }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # base...head diff for the classifier below
          # gh-1477: blobless — historical blobs are never read; git
          # lazy-fetches the rare blob a diff actually touches.
          filter: blob:none
      # Non-PR events (tags, schedule, dispatch): everything is
      # affected — the full gate always guards releases. Since gh-1537
      # there are NO main-push events at all; the SM validation dispatch
      # (workflow_dispatch on the rebased PR head) is the pre-merge gate
      # and lands in this arm, so every validation runs the whole-tree
      # gates (crap4dart baseline, coverage ratchet, jscpd) — nothing was
      # ever main-only.
      - id: filter
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        run: |
          echo "core=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "app=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "docs=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "shared=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      # PR classification runs through THE SAME classifier the pre-commit
      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path
      # rules, and the unknown-path safe default (full gate) — e.g. a new
      # dart_test.yaml at the repo root — now holds in CI, not only in the
      # hook. The selected stage set maps back to the same four groups the
      # old dorny filter emitted.
      - id: paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          # ── Issue #1267 N1/N2 dispatch arm ──────────────────────────────
          # SM validation dispatches carry NO pull_request event context,
          # so BASE_REF/HEAD_REF are empty there: derive the validated diff
          # from git — merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) is the PR fork point
          # (the checkout above is fetch-depth: 0, so origin/main exists).
          # merge-base == HEAD (a main dispatch, or an already-merged
          # branch) diffs to nothing and the narrowed arms skip. A failed
          # resolve fails SAFE: both arms run unconditioned —
          # over-triggering a rare-path leg costs minutes, under-triggering
          # one hides a nightly-only red (the #1309 class).
          if [ -z "$HEAD_REF" ]; then
            HEAD_REF="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
            BASE_REF="$(git merge-base origin/main "$HEAD_REF" 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -z "$BASE_REF" ]; then
              echo "::warning::merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) failed on the dispatch checkout — failing safe: exzone + locksmoke + installer + office_addin arms run"
              echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "office_addin=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set. Gated on
          # BOTH pull_request events and SM validation dispatches (the
          # legs below consult these outputs on either event). Context:
          # the ubuntu flutter-tests leg runs this family but every
          # engine-dependent test SKIPS there (native_test_guard.dart finds
          # no QuickJS .so on a bare runner); they truly execute only on
          # macOS — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307). The issue's
          # packages/js_widget_runtime/** is an EXTERNAL repo now, so its
          # bumps arrive via the flutter_app/pubspec.yaml pin.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^flutter_app/lib/apps/|^lib/src/js_ext/|^flutter_app/test/apps/|^flutter_app/test/native_test_guard\.dart$|^flutter_app/pubspec\.yaml$)'; then
            echo "exzone=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2): the lockfile-refresh vector — resolution
          # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible, and the breaking
          # arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview) lands as a
          # flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff with nothing else changed. The
          # flutter-app-lock-smoke legs are the pre-merge net; PRs not
          # touching the lockfile never pay for them.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '^flutter_app/pubspec\.lock$'; then
            echo "locksmoke=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          # gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: the installer generation pipeline — every
          # sh artifact under site/ and the generator that renders them.
          # Gated on the SAME two events as exzone/locksmoke (pull_request
          # + validation dispatch); the classifier failure arm above runs
          # it fail-safe.
          if git diff --name-only "$BASE_REF" "$HEAD_REF" |
              grep -qE '(^site/|^scripts/gen_installers\.dart$)'; then
            echo "installer=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

office-addin-suite:
    name: Office add-in suite
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    # Same two-event guard as exzone/locksmoke: pull_request + SM
    # validation dispatches. Tags/schedule/release never ran the suite
    # (the standalone push trigger was branches:[main] only) and skip it.
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
      needs.changes.outputs.office_addin == 'true' &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    # Ceiling for the daily addin watcher's budget arithmetic (#351):
    # dart + chrome-platform tests + add-in build + Playwright
    # chromium/webkit install & e2e; historically ~20m.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 22

      # office_addin/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root),
      # so its pub get must follow the root's.
      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      - name: Dart unit tests (office_addin/dart)
        run: cd office_addin/dart && dart pub get && dart test

      # The app build needs the gitignored placeholders (.env asset and
      # firebase_options.dart) — same dance pages.yml does.
      - name: App placeholders (.env + firebase_options)
        run: |
          touch [REDACTED:Credential File]
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      # gh-1310 rework (review thread 2): resolve flutter_app through the
      # shared retry action BEFORE the first flutter consumer — the package
      # config doesn't exist at checkout, so "Chrome boot tests" would
      # otherwise trigger flutter test's implicit (unenforced, unretried)
      # pub get first.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The office boot seam compiles web-only code, so its guard tests run
      # on the chrome platform (VM suite can't import them). FA_HOST=office
      # compiles the real boot branch in; Office.js is absent in the test
      # browser, pinning the clean office_unavailable failure path.
      - name: Chrome boot tests (flutter_app/test/web)
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter test test/web --platform chrome --dart-define=FA_HOST=office

      - name: Office wiring tests (flutter_app)
        run: cd flutter_app && flutter test test/services/office_wiring_test.dart

      # Validates the manifest (fails loudly on any issue), builds the
      # fa web app with FA_HOST=office and assembles the site slice —
      # the artifact under test AND the upload below.
      - name: Build Office add-in
        run: bash scripts/build_office_addin.sh

      # chromium + webkit: Outlook on the web runs the taskpane in
      # whichever engine the browser has, so both must boot the pane.
      - name: Playwright e2e (chromium + webkit)
        run: |
          cd office_addin/e2e
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium webkit
          npx playwright test --reporter=line

      - name: Upload assembled add-in
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: office-addin
          path: build/pages/root/outlook/
  # Issue #433: flutter_app CRAP ratchet — the app's beasts were never
  # gated (the root crap4dart.yaml covers core lib/bin only). The 2
  # flutter-tests shards above now emit --coverage; this job merges them
  # into ONE lcov (union DA hits, never cat — same as the core guards)
  # and runs the pinned crap4dart against flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
  # It is also the only home of the config guards: badge sync (AC1),
  # generated-exclude parity (E1) and the only-down git-history threshold
  # guard (AC3) — a raised threshold cannot merge, a new one (bootstrap)
  # can.
  app-crap-gate:
    name: Flutter app CRAP ratchet
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes, flutter-tests]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 6
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Scope fastpass (out-of-scope → green in seconds)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app != 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.shared != 'true'
        run: echo "no app/shared changes — flutter_app CRAP green-skipped (required context reported)"
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # only-down guard diffs thresholds against the base
          # gh-1477: blobless — historical blobs are never read.
          filter: blob:none
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          sdk: stable

# Daily auto-publish (issue #161): thin orchestrator over the existing
# publish channels. Each channel is an isolated leg — one leg failing never
# kills the others — and every failure self-files a deduplicated GitHub
# issue (label `bug`, assigned to the owner) that auto-closes when the leg
# goes green again. No publish logic is duplicated here: legs dispatch the
# existing workflows via `gh workflow run` and watch them.
#
#   testflight  build-mobile.yml   ios_content=all (the iOS half of the
#                                 mobile build)
#   play        build-mobile.yml   android_content=all,
#                                 android_track=beta (Android external
#                                 beta / open testing — issue #289 lifts
#                                 the standing "Android excluded" owner
#                                 decision for the release track; #947
#                                 adds the listing deploy — texts +
#                                 whole-set image replace + verify — so
#                                 the listing never trails the goldens;
#                                 the leg green-skips while the Play
#                                 secrets are absent)
#   pubdev      in-job OIDC publish, only when pubspec > pub.dev; otherwise
#               a green up-to-date check. The tag-time OIDC publish job
#               (ci.yml) stays the primary path; this leg is the catch-up +
#               loud-failure detector (e.g. expired publish credentials)
#   cli         build-macos.yml    desktop DMG + macOS CLI bundles +
#                                 extension, attached to the next-tag
#                                 release (version passed explicitly so
#                                 mobile/desktop never mint diverging tags)
#   website     pages.yml          fa1.dev (landing + web demo + extension
#                                 + the /outlook add-in slice)
#   addin       office-addin.yml   manifest/taskpane acceptance suite; the
#                                 fa1.dev publish itself rides the website
#                                 leg (pages.yml assembles /outlook)
#
# Legs run only when main moved since the last GREEN daily run — skip-no-
# change is green-neutral, never red (#159 lesson). One exception (gh-1192):
# while main's pubspec version is not yet served by pub.dev the plan gate
# (scripts/daily_plan.sh) forces the legs anyway — a release-in-flight
# green must not become a skip baseline that stalls re-verification and
# rerun-recovery on a quiet main. Versioning stays the
# existing scheme: auto_release.sh patch-bumps + tags every main push
# (2h coalesce); the daily attaches mobile/desktop artifacts to the next
# tag and verifies/republishes pub.dev. See docs/ci.md.
#
# Pause: gh workflow disable daily-publish.yml -R IstiN/flutter_agent_harness

run-name: "Daily auto-publish (${{ inputs.legs || 'all' }})"

on:
  schedule:

    inputs:
      legs:

        type: choice
        default: all
        options:
          - all
          - testflight
          - play
          - pubdev
          - cli
          - website
          - addin
      force:
        description: 'Run even if main has not moved since the last green daily'
        type: boolean
        default: false
      inject_failure:
        description: 'TEST ONLY — fail this leg before any dispatch, to exercise the self-filing issue cycle'
        type: choice
        default: none
        options:
          - none
          - testflight
          - play
          - pubdev
          - cli
          - website
          - addin

permissions:

# One daily at a time; a queued run must not cancel an in-flight one.
concurrency:
  group: daily-publish
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  plan:
    name: Plan (change detection + versions)

release:
    name: Auto-release (tag cut)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, quality-gate]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    # gh-1522: the release IS the tag. gh-1537: NO main-push arm — ci.yml
    # no longer triggers on pushes to main (the post-merge main CI run is
    # retired), so releases arm on the 2h coalesce schedule and the two
    # gated dispatches only. Every armed tick cuts an annotated tag
    # (latest tag + 1) on origin/main plus the GitHub Release — coalesced
    # to <=1 per 2h (pub.dev rate-limits publishes, ~12/day; hit on
    # 2026-07-18). ZERO commits land on main: the retired flow pushed a
    # 4-file 'chore(release):' bot commit (pubspec.yaml, CHANGELOG.md,
    # flutter_app/pubspec.{yaml,lock}); the tag now drives everything and
    # CI stamps version/changelog into the STAGED publish tree at publish
    # time. The tag push rides the fa-release-bot App token because
    # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped publish/binaries
    # jobs (gh-1172); the App no longer needs the main-ruleset bypass (no
    # branch push), but remains the release-path actor (gh-1402).
    # Scheduled runs catch up commits that outpaced the coalesce window.
    # !cancelled() + explicit gate check: GitHub propagates "skipped"
    # TRANSITIVELY through an always()-job's needs graph. quality-gate uses
    # if: always() and its needs include path-gated legs (perf-gate etc.)
    # that skip on ordinary pushes — without !cancelled() this job was
    # force-skipped on EVERY run since the perf gate landed (fa#456),
    # silently killing auto-release for a week. The explicit result check
    # keeps the gate red-line: no release on a failed quality gate.
    # workflow_dispatch reaches this job ONLY through an explicit input gate
    # (gh-1172 round-2 BLOCK): this is the repo's dispatch-only CI — the SM
    # runs `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <pr-branch>` with no inputs, so a
    # bare dispatch arm would execute the dispatched (PR-head) ref's
    # auto_release.sh with the App's tag-push credentials. releaseDryRun
    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      (github.event_name == 'schedule'
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.releaseDryRun == true)
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.releaseDispatch == true)) &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    # Defense in depth (gh-1172 round-3 BLOCK): the tag push rides the
    # checkout App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs
    # write — on a dry-run dispatch of a PR head (AC1, any ref) that keeps
    # the job's own token read-only, leaving no write-capable credential in
    # the run.
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # Job-scoped App token (gh-1172 fix-contract item 1): minted per run,
      # expires with the job, never shared with other workflows.
      # NEVER minted on a dry-run dispatch: that arm fires on ANY ref, so the
      # credential must not exist in a run that executes the (possibly
      # untrusted) dispatched ref's auto_release.sh — "dry-run never pushes"
      # may not depend on the script under test honoring the flag. The real
      # arms (schedule, releaseDispatch — gh-1537 retired the main-push
      # trigger, so there is no push arm) see a non-true releaseDryRun
      # and mint as before.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        if: inputs.releaseDryRun != true
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write covers
          # the tag push + `gh release create`, nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token (not GITHUB_TOKEN) so the pushed tag triggers the
          # tag-scoped publish/binaries jobs — GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never
          # trigger downstream workflow runs.
          # Dry-run dispatch: the mint above is skipped, its outputs are
          # empty (falsy) and checkout falls back to the plain GITHUB_TOKEN
          # (read-only per the job permissions block).
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}

      - name: Cut release tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          RELEASE_DRY_RUN: ${{ github.event.inputs.releaseDryRun == 'true' && '1' || '0' }}
          # gh release create rides the App token (gh-1172): without an
          # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in auto_release.sh would be
          # a guaranteed silent no-op and the curated notes would never reach
          # the release object.
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

    name: Build web (debug)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # Pinned to the same SDK as the release path (#281): 3.47.x. The
      # action's cache key embeds the resolved SDK version, so an SDK bump
      # in a PR never restores a poisoned cache (E1).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: flutter build web
        # E3: warnings (including the Wasm dry-run diagnostics) are allowed;

blocks.text:
name: Build macOS Release (Fa)

# Issue #343: the daily-publish CLI leg and a human can dispatch this
# workflow in the same window; the run-name embeds the input so the
# watcher's displayTitle match (the only distinguisher in the run-list
# API) never adopts someone else's run.
run-name: "build-macos (create_release=${{ inputs.create_release }})"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version (e.g. v0.0.2) or "auto" to increment patch'
        required: false
        default: 'auto'
      create_release:
        description: 'Create GitHub Release'
        required: false
        default: 'true'
        type: choice
        options:
          - 'true'
          - 'false'

# Release builds are never preempted (issue #194 pt 5, same principle as
# ci.yml: tag/release runs must not be cancelled mid-flight; gh-1537
# retired the post-merge main ci run).
concurrency:
  group: Build macOS Release (Fa)-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

# SEC-08 (#796): minimal default — release-attaching jobs grant
# contents: write in their own job-level blocks.
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  version:
    name: Derive version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Explicit ceiling so the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351)
    # has a real per-job bound instead of GitHub's 360m default. gh-1477:
    # 10m was a time bomb — the full-history fetch outgrew its twin in
    # build-mobile (run 38027695551). 20m + the blobless filter below.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1477: this job reads ONLY `git tag` — a full clone transfers
          # every blob ever written and the repo grows daily, so the fetch
          # outgrew the old 10m ceiling (run 38027695551). Blobless keeps
          # full tag/commit metadata without the blobs.
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - name: Derive build version
        id: version
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          INPUT="${{ inputs.version }}"
          if [ -z "$INPUT" ] || [ "$INPUT" = "auto" ]; then
            LATEST=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1 || echo "")
            if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then
              TAG="v0.0.1"
              echo "No previous tag found — starting at $TAG"
            else
              MAJOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\1/')
              MINOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\2/')
              PATCH=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\3/')
              PATCH=$((PATCH + 1))
              TAG="v${MAJOR}.${MINOR}.${PATCH}"
              echo "Previous tag: $LATEST → auto-increment to $TAG"
            fi
          else
            TAG="$INPUT"
            [[ "$TAG" != v* ]] && TAG="v$TAG"
            echo "Using manual version: $TAG"
          fi
          VERSION_CLEAN="${TAG#v}"
          echo "version=$VERSION_CLEAN" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  build-macos:
    name: Build macOS ${{ matrix.arch }}
    needs: version
    # gh-1600 F-A: pin the ONE self-hosted macOS runner (fa-m5-1) via its
    # unique registration label — the generic [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]
    # list also matched the Linux self-hosted box's labels (same routing
    # bug that sent the build-mobile iOS jobs to Linux, gh-1600).
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macos-m5]
    # Issue #239: TestFlight submit now waits for Apple processing (bounded,
    # default 90 min) + a ~1-min one-shot appearance probe AFTER the
    # build/notarize work (gh-1041: the blocking distribution wait moved to
    # the deferred store-appearance-check workflow) — the job ceiling must
    # cover the worst case, not just the build.
    timeout-minutes: 150
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        arch: [arm64, x86_64]
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      # Workaround: force .NET (used by the runner) to use SocketsHttpHandler
      # instead of Apple's SSL APIs, avoiding "bad certificate format" errors
      # caused by corporate Zscaler/MDM certificates in the system keychain.
      DOTNET_SYSTEM_NET_HTTP_USESOCKETSHTTPHANDLER: "0"

    steps:
      # ── Prepare persistent local git mirrors ────────────────────────────────
      # gh-1644: the old inline single-shot logic died on the first network
      # hiccup — the recreate fell through to a full `git clone --mirror`
      # whose ~1 h transfer ended in "error: 2931 bytes of body are still
      # expected" (run 38855793382, exit 128). The shared script retries the
      # fetch with VISIBLE stderr, aborts stalled attempts, and recreates
      # BLOBLESS (--filter=blob:none, the gh-1477 precedent) with retries and
      # partial-dir cleanup. Contract: scripts/update_git_mirror_selftest.sh
      # gh-1665 review: this step runs BEFORE any checkout on persistent
      # self-hosted runners — the workspace may hold a pre-merge tree (or be
      # wiped), so the script is bootstrapped from the commit-pinned raw URL
      # (workflow_dispatch-only workflows ⇒ ${{ github.sha }} is always a
      # pushed commit) with the mirror copy as the no-network fallback.
      - name: Update local git mirrors
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MIRROR_BASE="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/mirror"
          mkdir -p "$MIRROR_BASE"
          MIRROR="$MIRROR_BASE/flutter_agent_harness.git"
          SCRIPT="$RUNNER_TEMP/update_git_mirror.sh"
          RAW="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/${{ github.sha }}/scripts/update_git_mirror.sh"
          if ! curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 "$RAW" -o "$SCRIPT" \
             || [ ! -s "$SCRIPT" ]; then
            echo "raw bootstrap failed — syncing the mirror and falling back to its copy" >&2
            # gh-1665 review (returned IMPORTANT): in the one-run-wide
            # first-post-merge window the persistent mirror is still a
            # PRE-MERGE tree. Cheap single-shot ensure (bounded resilience
            # stays owned by $SCRIPT below) so the extraction that follows
            # succeeds on any runner that can reach github.com at all —
            # raw.githubusercontent.com being down degrades to the
            # fallback instead of a red leg.
            if [ -d "$MIRROR" ] && git -C "$MIRROR" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              git -C "$MIRROR" fetch origin || true
            else
              rm -rf "$MIRROR"
              git clone --mirror https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git "$MIRROR" || true
            fi
            BRANCH="$(git --git-dir="$MIRROR" symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo main)"
            git --git-dir="$MIRROR" show "$BRANCH:scripts/update_git_mirror.sh" > "$SCRIPT" \
              || { echo "::error::could not bootstrap update_git_mirror.sh (raw URL unreachable and mirror lacks the script)" >&2; exit 1; }
          fi
          bash "$SCRIPT" \
            https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git \
            "$MIRROR"

      # ── Checkout ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      # gh-1600 AC2: hardened mirror-checkout — the bare `rm -rf
      # "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"` used to fail the whole checkout on stale
      # unremovable leftovers in the persistent shared workspace (bench
      # docker leftovers, jobs/fa-2.1-docker-cpu-14/). Log-and-prune clean +
      # clone-around-stub; the per-arch build cache is parked outside the
      # workspace before the clean and restored after the clone (best-effort:
      # a lost cache re-builds from scratch, it never fails the checkout).
      # INLINE (not a composite action) on purpose: local `uses: ./...`
      # actions resolve against $GITHUB_WORKSPACE at step time — on this box
      # that is the PREVIOUS run's tree, and this step IS the chec…

# Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  build-extension:
    name: Build Chrome extension
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - name: dart pub get (root)
        run: dart pub get

      # browser_ext/dart is a separate package (path dep on this root), so
      # its pub get must follow the root's — same as browser-ext.yml.
      - name: dart pub get (browser_ext/dart)
        run: cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

      # Full artifact: SW agent (dart2js) + the Flutter panel app embedded,
      # exactly what "Load unpacked" expects. --clobber keeps the stable
      # asset name fa-extension.zip pointing at the newest build (the
      # landing page links it directly).
      - name: Build extension zip
        run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate
      # against the committed v1.0.493 release baseline. Shrink passes;
      # growth (e.g. a dropped interpreter re-added) fails the release.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (fa-extension.zip)
        run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv

      - name: Upload extension to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          asset="fa-extension.zip"
          cp build/fa-extension.zip "$asset"
          ls -lh "$asset"

          # Ensure the release exists (race-safe with release-macos). Title
          # is the bare tag vX.Y.Z (issue #282), latest is explicit.
          if ! gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --title "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest \
              --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" || true
          fi
          gh release upload "$RELEASE_TAG" "$asset" --clobber --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): this job creates releases,
      # so a failed/cancelled run must not leave one behind as a draft.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: always() && job.status != 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PAT }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

  release-macos:
    name: Create macOS GitHub Release
    needs: [version, build-macos]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 15
    if: inputs.create_release == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # Full history: release_notes.sh falls back to "commits since the
          # previous tag" when the CHANGELOG has no section for this version.
          # gh-1477: blobless — the notes read commit MESSAGES, never
          # historical file blobs.
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - name: Download DMG artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          path: dmgs
          pattern: Fa-macos-*
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: List downloaded artifacts
        run: ls -laR dmgs/

      - name: Merge macOS auto-update manifest
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install --user pyyaml
          chmod +x scripts/merge-mac-update-manifest.sh
          scripts/merge-mac-update-manifest.sh dmgs dmgs/latest-mac.yml
          cat dmgs/latest-mac.yml

      - name: Create or update GitHub Release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          DMGS=$(ls dmgs/*.dmg 2>/dev/null || true)
          ZIPS=$(ls dmgs/*-mac.zip 2>/dev/null || true)
          MANIFEST="dmgs/latest-mac.yml"
          echo "DMGs to upload: $DMGS"
          echo "ZIPs to upload: $ZIPS"

          STABLE_COPIES=()
          for zip in $ZIPS; do
            base=$(basename "$zip")
            # Skip no-sandbox zips from the auto-update stable names; the
            # sandboxed build is the default update feed.
            if [[ "$base" == *nosandbox* ]]; then
              continue
            fi
            if [[ "$base" == *arm64* ]]; then
              cp "$zip" "dmgs/fa-macos-arm64-mac.zip"
              STABLE_COPIES+=("dmgs/fa-macos-arm64-mac.zip")
            elif [[ "$base" == *x86_64* ]]; then
              cp "$zip" "dmgs/fa-macos-x64-mac.zip"
              STABLE_COPIES+=("dmgs/fa-macos-x64-mac.zip")
            fi
          done

          # Extract the raw binary from the .app bundle and upload it as the
          # plain asset name (fa-macos-arm64 / fa-macos-x64) so `fa update`
          # and direct downloads work without knowing the version suffix.
          for zip in $ZIPS; do
            base=$(basename "$zip")
            if [[ "$base" == *nosandbox* ]]; then
              continue
            fi
            unzip -qo "$zip" -d /tmp/fa-extract >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
            BIN="/tmp/fa-extract/Fa.app/Contents/MacOS/Fa"
            if [ -f "$BIN" ]; then
              if [[ "$base" == *arm64* ]]; then
                cp "$BIN" "dmgs/fa-macos-arm64"
                ASSETS+=("dmgs/fa-macos-arm64")
              elif [[ "$base" == *x86_64* ]]; then
                cp "$BIN" "dmgs/fa-macos-x64"
                ASSETS+=("dmgs/fa-macos-x64")
              fi
              chmod +x "dmgs/fa-macos-arm64" "dmgs/fa-macos-x64" 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
            rm -rf /tmp/fa-extract
          done
          ASSETS=($DMGS $ZIPS $MANIFEST "${STABLE_COPIES[@]}")

          # Notes come from the CHANGELOG section for this version, with a
          # conventional-commit fallback (issue #282: no more filler
          # bodies); the install hints stay as a footer.
          bash scripts/release_notes.sh "$RELEASE_TAG" > release-notes.md || true
          printf '\n## Installation\n- **macOS**: Download the DMG for your architecture (`arm64` for Apple Silicon, `x86_64` for Intel) and drag Fa.app to Applications. In-app updates use the ZIP + latest-mac.yml feed.\n- **Linux**: Download tar.gz, extract and run the `bundle/fa` binary.\n- **Windows**: Download zip, extract and run the `fa.exe`.\n' >> release-notes.md

          # Attach-or-create (issue #282 E3 + review of #294): idempotent
          # against the view->create race - a lost race uploads into the
          # winner's release instead of failing - and the create stamps an
          # ownership marker into the draft body, so the guard step below
          # only ever deletes THIS job's draft, never the mobile leg's
          # mid-upload draft on the same derived tag.
          bash scripts/release_attach_or_create.sh "$RELEASE_TAG" "${ASSETS[@]}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): the create above uploads
      # assets through a draft — a failed/cancelled run must delete it,
      # never orphan it (the v0.1.190 rot). Ownership-scoped…

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Per-artifact uncompressed size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1).

Emits the per-entry uncompressed size table (the issue's inventory format)
for a shipped artifact and fails the build when any tracked line regresses
beyond the budget (default +5%).

Usage:
  size_manifest.py emit   <artifact> [--min-bytes N]        # TSV to stdout
  size_manifest.py check  <artifact> --baseline FILE
                          [--budget-pct 5] [--init-if-missing]
                          [--manifest-out FILE] [--forbid REGEX]...
                          [--vendored REGEX]... [--strict-vendored]
  size_manifest.py selftest

`<artifact>` is a zip-family file (.zip/.ipa/.aab — uncompressed entry sizes
via zipfile) or a directory (tree of file sizes, for the web deploy root).

Manifest format (TSV; every row is `<bytes>\t<name>`, path-sorted. TOTAL
is an ordinary row — `<total_bytes>\tTOTAL` — and sorts among the paths;
do not rely on its position, the parser keys by name):
  <uncompressed_bytes>\t<path>
  <total_bytes>\tTOTAL

Rev-hash path normalization (#1431): a path segment of 20+ hex chars is
a content/rev-hash directory — the Flutter engine renderer artifacts
(canvaskit/skwasm) move under a new one on every 3.47.x patch drop while
the byte sizes stay identical. Both the artifact scan and the baseline
load collapse such segments to `<rev>` BEFORE diffing, so an engine rev
bump lands as an in-place UPDATE (the usual size-band compare) instead
of N brand-new heavyweight lines. Normalization is idempotent, so
pre-fix baselines carrying the literal rev hash migrate on load — no
baseline rewrite needed. Colliding normalized rows (two rev dirs in one
artifact, e.g. stale files) merge to the heavier one.

Gate semantics (`check`):
  - growth > budget%% on any baseline line or on the first-party TOTAL
    -> FAIL
  - NEW line heavier than 5%% of the baseline first-party TOTAL -> FAIL
    (catches re-adding removed weight, e.g. a dropped interpreter coming
    back — re-growth must be a conscious ack)
  - VENDORED carve-out (#1431): rows under a vendored prefix (default:
    the canvaskit/ engine-renderer subtree; extend with --vendored
    REGEX) are engine payload, not our growth — their breaches print
    ::warning and stay out of the failure count, and they are excluded
    from the TOTAL the budget compares (first-party TOTAL = TOTAL minus
    vendored rows). The engine reving is not the payload growing.
    --strict-vendored turns the carve-out off (everything gates again).
  - removed lines are improvements, reported only
  - --init-if-missing: no baseline file yet -> write it and pass with a
    loud notice (ratchet bootstrap; commit the file to arm the gate)
  - --reseed: overwrite an EXISTING baseline from this artifact and pass
    with a notice — the escape hatch for intentional growth; commit the
    rewritten file to make the new shape the floor
  - --forbid REGEX (repeatable): any manifest row whose path matches
    REGEX fails the check immediately, regardless of the +5% budget or
    the NEW-line share — the deny-list for evicted artifacts (a re-added
    5.6 MB fixture slips under both: NEW share is 5% of TOTAL). Enforced
    on check, --init-if-missing AND --reseed: re-admitting an artifact
    means dropping its --forbid flag, a conscious ack. The deny-list
    floor equals the tracking floor: sub-MIN_BYTES rows never enter the
    manifest.

CI escape hatch for intentional growth: re-run locally with the same
artifact and `--reseed`, commit the rewritten baseline.
"""

import argparse
import re
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

# Per-line tracking floor: smaller files are noise (thousands of them
# jitter by whole percentages); the TOTAL line covers their aggregate.
MIN_BYTES = 64 * 1024
# A brand-new tracked line heavier than this share of the old first-party
# TOTAL is re-growth, not rounding — fail it.
NEW_LINE_SHARE = 0.05
# A path segment of 20+ hex chars is a content/rev-hash directory: the
# Flutter engine renderer artifacts (canvaskit/skwasm wasm) ship under
# `canvaskit/<rev>/` and the rev changes on every 3.47.x patch drop
# (#1431). Collapsed to <rev> on BOTH the artifact scan and the baseline
# load so rev churn diffs as an in-place UPDATE, not N new lines.
REV_SEGMENT_RE = re.compile(r"(^|/)[0-9a-fA-F]{20,}(?=/|$)")
REV_PLACEHOLDER = "<rev>"
# Rows matching a vendored prefix are engine/vendor payload: their
# breaches warn instead of failing (#1431). The canvaskit/ subtree
# carries every engine renderer artifact (canvaskit/skwasm/wimp/
# webparagraph, chromium variant included). First-party paths —
# including our own shipped vendor/interpreters payload — keep the
# full rule.
VENDORED_DEFAULTS = [r"(^|/)canvaskit/"]


def normalize_revpaths(name: str) -> str:
    """Collapse 20+hex path segments (engine rev dirs) to <rev> (#1431)."""
    return REV_SEGMENT_RE.sub(lambda m: m.group(1) + REV_PLACEHOLDER, name)


def iter_sizes(artifact: Path):
    """Yield (path, uncompressed_bytes) for every file in the artifact."""
    if artifact.is_file():
        # zip-family: .zip / .ipa / .aab / .apk
        with zipfile.ZipFile(artifact) as zf:
            for info in zf.infolist():
                if info.is_dir():
                    continue
                yield info.filename.replace("\t", " "), info.file_size
        return
    if artifact.is_dir():
        for p in sorted(artifact.rglob("*")):
            if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink():
                yield p.relative_to(artifact).as_posix().replace("\t", " "), p.stat().st_size
        return
    raise SystemExit(f"size_manifest: artifact not found: {artifact}")


def build_manifest(artifact: Path, min_bytes: int) -> "dict[str, int]":
    sizes = dict(iter_sizes(artifact))
    manifest = {}
    for p, n in sizes.items():
        if n < min_bytes:
            continue
        key = normalize_revpaths(p)
        # Two rev dirs in one artifact (stale files) collide post-
        # normalization: keep the heavier row on both floor and current.
        if key not in manifest or manifest[key] < n:
            manifest[key] = n
    manifest["TOTAL"] = sum(sizes.values())
    return manifest


def fmt_table(manifest: "dict[str, int]") -> str:
    width = max((len(p) for p in manifest), default=5)
    lines = [f"{manifest[p]:>12}  {p.ljust(width)}" for p in sorted(manifest) if p != "TOTAL"]
    lines.append("-" * (width + 14))
    lines.append(f"{manifest['TOTAL']:>12}  TOTAL")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def load_baseline(path: Path) -> "dict[str, int]":
    baseline = {}
    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        size, _, name = line.partition("\t")
        key = normalize_revpaths(name)  # pre-fix literal-rev rows migrate
        if key not in baseline or baseline[key] < int(size):
            baseline[key] = int(size)
    if "TOTAL" not in baseline:
        raise SystemExit(f"size_manifest: baseline {path} has no TOTAL line")
    return baseline


def write_baseline(path: Path, manifest: "dict[str, int]") -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lines = [f"{manifest[p]}\t{p}" for p in sorted(manifest)]
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")


def check(artifact: Path, baseline_path: Path, budget_pct: float,
          init_if_missing: bool = False, reseed: bool = False,
          manifest_out=None, forbid=None, vendored=None,
          strict_vendored=False) -> int:
    manifest = build_manifest(artifact, MIN_BYTES)
    if manifest_out:
        write_baseline(manifest_out, manifest)

    # Deny-list (gh-1331 review): a returning evicted artifact fails the
    # gate in every mode — budget and NEW-line share both miss sub-5%
    # re-adds, so eviction is pinned by pattern, not by the floor.
    forbid_res = [re.compile(p) for p in forbid or []]
    if forbid_res:
        banned = [name for name in sorted(manifest)
                  if name != "TOTAL" and any(r.search(name) for r in forbid_res)]
        if banned:
            for name in banned:
                print(f"::error::size_manifest: FORBIDDEN row in {artifact}: "
                    …

quality-gate:
    name: Quality gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes, static, flutter-analyze, test-core, coverage-gate, guards, flutter-tests, app-crap-gate, test-faui, perf-gate, usage-fold, cli-visual-settings, cube-kernel-live, build-web, build-android, build-ios, build-macos, integration-mock, hostile-env, fa-aot-build, pty-integration-linux, pty-coverage-gate, pty-visual, supply-chain, dep-audit, installer-portability, installer-verify, install-pin-gate, flutter-app-exzone, flutter-app-lock-smoke, office-addin-suite]
    if: always() && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    # #1368: the publish job consumes dart_ok — the pure-Dart package verdict
    # — instead of this aggregate's result. The aggregate itself stays the
    # single required check: any red leg (platform included) still fails it.
    outputs:
      dart_ok: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.dart_ok }}
    steps:
      - name: Report leg results
        run: |
          echo "static        = ${{ needs.static.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "test-core     = ${{ needs.test-core.result }}"
          echo "coverage-gate = ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}"
          echo "guards        = ${{ needs.guards.result }}"
          echo "flutter-analyze = ${{ needs.flutter-analyze.result }}"
          echo "flutter-tests = ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}"
          echo "test-faui     = ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}"
          echo "app-crap-gate = ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}"
          echo "perf-gate     = ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}"
          echo "usage-fold    = ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}"
          echo "cube-live     = ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}"
          echo "cli-visual    = ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}"
          echo "build-web     = ${{ needs.build-web.result }}"
          echo "build-android = ${{ needs.build-android.result }}"
          echo "build-ios     = ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}"
          echo "build-macos   = ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}"
          echo "integ-mock    = ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}"
          echo "hostile-env   = ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}"
          echo "pty-integ-linux = ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}"
          echo "fa-aot-build  = ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}"
          echo "pty-gates     = ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}"
          echo "pty-visual    = ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}"
          echo "supply-chain  = ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}"
          echo "dep-audit     = ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}"
          echo "installer-it = ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}"
          echo "installer-reg  = ${{ needs.installer-portability.result }}"
          echo "pin-gate    = ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}"
          echo "exzone      = ${{ needs.flutter-app-exzone.result }}"
          echo "lock-smoke  = ${{ needs.flutter-app-lock-smoke.result }}"
          echo "office-addin  = ${{ needs.office-addin-suite.result }}"
      - name: Fail on any real failure (skipped security = dodge = FAIL)
        id: gate
        env:
          R_CHANGES: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          R_SUPPLY_CHAIN: ${{ needs.supply-chain.result }}
          R_DEP_AUDIT: ${{ needs.dep-audit.result }}
          R_STATIC: ${{ needs.static.result }}
          R_FLUTTER_ANALYZE: ${{ needs.flutter-analyze.result }}
          R_TEST_CORE: ${{ needs.test-core.result }}
          R_COVERAGE: ${{ needs.coverage-gate.result }}
          R_GUARDS: ${{ needs.guards.result }}
          R_FLUTTER: ${{ needs.flutter-tests.result }}
          R_CRAP: ${{ needs.app-crap-gate.result }}
          R_FAUI: ${{ needs.test-faui.result }}
          R_PERF: ${{ needs.perf-gate.result }}
          R_USAGE_FOLD: ${{ needs.usage-fold.result }}
          R_CUBE: ${{ needs.cube-kernel-live.result }}
          R_CLI_VISUAL: ${{ needs.cli-visual-settings.result }}
          R_BUILD_WEB: ${{ needs.build-web.result }}
          R_BUILD_ANDROID: ${{ needs.build-android.result }}
          R_BUILD_IOS: ${{ needs.build-ios.result }}
          R_BUILD_MACOS: ${{ needs.build-macos.result }}
          R_INTEG: ${{ needs.integration-mock.result }}
          R_HOSTILE: ${{ needs.hostile-env.result }}
          R_PTY_LINUX: ${{ needs.pty-integration-linux.result }}
          R_FA_AOT: ${{ needs.fa-aot-build.result }}
          R_PTY_GATES: ${{ needs.pty-coverage-gate.result }}
          R_PTY_VISUAL: ${{ needs.pty-visual.result }}
          R_INSTALLER_VERIFY: ${{ needs.installer-verify.result }}
          R_INSTALLER_REG: ${{ needs.installer-portability.result }}
          R_INSTALL_PIN_GATE: ${{ needs.install-pin-gate.result }}
          R_EXZONE: ${{ needs.flutter-app-exzone.result }}
          R_LOCK_SMOKE: ${{ needs.flutter-app-lock-smoke.result }}
          R_OFFICE_ADDIN: ${{ needs.office-addin-suite.result }}
        run: |
          fail() { echo "Quality gate FAILED: $1"; exit 1; }
          # Verdict pass collects blockers WITHOUT exiting, so dart_ok is
          # always exported explicitly ('true' or 'false', never '') —
          # publish and the Provider smoke read this output and an empty
          # value must never read as either (review thread on #1370).
          dart_blocker=""
          # The classifier itself must have run: a failed or skipped
          # classifier skips EVERY downstream leg and would wave a PR
          # through with zero gates executed.
          [ "$R_CHANGES" = "success" ] || dart_blocker="changes classifier = $R_CHANGES"
          # Security legs must EXECUTE and pass. For these, skipped is a
          # dodge (e.g. a cunning diff that makes the classifier misfire),

changes:
    name: Classify changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips the classifier too — every downstream leg is gated on
    # release-pending and would skip anyway, so classifying would be
    # wasted work (and a skipped classifier with empty outputs would
    # wave every changes-keyed leg past its path gate).
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      core: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.core || steps.filter.outputs.core }}
      app: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.app || steps.filter.outputs.app }}
      docs: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.docs || steps.filter.outputs.docs }}
      shared: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.shared || steps.filter.outputs.shared }}
      # PR-only (issue #303): a trajectory-touching diff flips this on so
      # the perf-gate leg below runs the #262 DoD gate per-merge.
      perf: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.perf }}
      # PR-only (gh-1241 REG-1): a trajectory/session/usage-touching diff
      # runs the usage-fold suite per-merge.
      usagefold: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.usagefold }}
      # Issue #1267 N1: the macOS exclusion-zone path set — live on
      # pull_request events AND on SM validation dispatches: the paths
      # step derives the validated diff from merge-base(origin/main, HEAD)
      # when no pull_request context exists (fail-safe — a classification
      # failure runs the leg, never skips it).
      exzone: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.exzone }}
      # Issue #1267 N2: the diff modified flutter_app/pubspec.lock — the
      # transitive-drift vector that kept linux/windows release builds red
      # for five nights (#1265). Same path-triggered model as exzone.
      locksmoke: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.locksmoke }}
      # PR-only (issue #551): test/integration/** changes run the no-key
      # mock-LLM integration legs per-PR instead of at tag time only.
      intmock: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.intmock }}
      # gh-1596 REG-1/REG-2: a diff touching the installer generation
      # pipeline (site/** or scripts/gen_installers.dart) runs the
      # sh-portability legs — template lint, golden drift, and the piped
      # wizard under dash (ubuntu) / bash (macOS).

      # retired standalone office-addin.yml push/PR triggers carried,
      # gated on pull_request + SM validation dispatches like
      # exzone/locksmoke (tags/schedule never ran the suite and skip it).
      office_addin: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.office_addin }}

      # hook uses (issue #194, AC7 + AC5/E2): one source of truth for path

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Package browser_ext/ into build/fa-extension.zip (runtime files only:
# manifest, sw/, content/, panel/ — README, dart/ sources, test/, and
# compiled artifacts' side files stay out).
# `--with-app` first builds the Flutter web app (flutter_app/ → build/web) and
# bundles it as browser_ext/app/ so the side panel hosts the full fa app.
# browser_ext/app/ is a build artifact (gitignored, never committed).
# Compiles the embedded Dart agent first when a Dart SDK is available
# (scripts must FAIL LOUDLY on compile errors — CI always builds it).
# Without dart: a previously built sw/agent.js ships if present, else the
# zip is scaffold-only with a warning (never a failure).

set -euo pipefail

with_app=0
case "${1:-}" in
  --with-app) with_app=1 ;;
  "") ;;
  *) echo "unknown option: $1 (usage: $0 [--with-app])" >&2; exit 1 ;;

manifest=browser_ext/manifest.json

# JSON validators are not) — strip them before validating, the same
# regex test/browser_ext/chrome_driver.dart uses.

import json, re, sys
raw = open(sys.argv[1]).read()
json.loads(re.sub(r"^\s*//.*$", "", raw, flags=re.M))
' "$manifest"

# Daily auto-publish (issue #161): thin orchestrator over the existing
# publish channels. Each channel is an isolated leg — one leg failing never
# kills the others — and every failure self-files a deduplicated GitHub
# issue (label `bug`, assigned to the owner) that auto-closes when the leg
# goes green again. No publish logic is duplicated here: legs dispatch the
# existing workflows via `gh workflow run` and watch them.
#
#   testflight  build-mobile.yml   ios_content=all (the iOS half of the
#                                 mobile build)
#   play        build-mobile.yml   android_content=all,
#                                 android_track=beta (Android external
#                                 beta / open testing — issue #289 lifts
#                                 the standing "Android excluded" owner
#                                 decision for the release track; #947
#                                 adds the listing deploy — texts +
#                                 whole-set image replace + verify — so
#                                 the listing never trails the goldens;
#                                 the leg green-skips while the Play
#                                 secrets are absent)
#   pubdev      in-job OIDC publish, only when pubspec > pub.dev; otherwise
#               a green up-to-date check. The tag-time OIDC publish job
#               (ci.yml) stays the primary path; this leg is the catch-up +
#               loud-failure detector (e.g. expired publish credentials)
#   cli         build-macos.yml    desktop DMG + macOS CLI bundles +
#                                 extension, attached to the next-tag
#                                 release (version passed explicitly so
#                                 mobile/desktop never mint diverging tags)
#   website     pages.yml          fa1.dev (landing + web demo + extension
#                                 + the /outlook add-in slice)
#   addin       office-addin.yml   manifest/taskpane acceptance suite; the
#                                 fa1.dev publish itself rides the website
#                                 leg (pages.yml assembles /outlook)
#
# Legs run only when main moved since the last GREEN daily run — skip-no-
# change is green-neutral, never red (#159 lesson). One exception (gh-1192):
# while main's pubspec version is not yet served by pub.dev the plan gate
# (scripts/daily_plan.sh) forces the legs anyway — a release-in-flight
# green must not become a skip baseline that stalls re-verification and
# rerun-recovery on a quiet main. Versioning stays the
# existing scheme: auto_release.sh patch-bumps + tags every main push
# (2h coalesce); the daily attaches mobile/desktop artifacts to the next
# tag and verifies/republishes pub.dev. See docs/ci.md.

# Pause: gh workflow disable daily-publish.yml -R IstiN/flutter_agent_harness

        type: choice
        default: all
        options:

          - testflight
          - play
          - pubdev
          - cli
          - website
          - addin
      force:
        description: 'Run even if main has not moved since the last green daily'
        type: boolean
        default: false
      inject_failure:
        description: 'TEST ONLY — fail this leg before any dispatch, to exercise the self-filing issue cycle'
        type: choice
        default: none
        options:
          - none
          - testflight
          - play
          - pubdev
          - cli
          - website
          - addin

permissions:

# One daily at a time; a queued run must not cancel an in-flight one.
concurrency:
  group: daily-publish

jobs:

release:
    name: Auto-release (tag cut)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, quality-gate]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    # gh-1522: the release IS the tag. gh-1537: NO main-push arm — ci.yml
    # no longer triggers on pushes to main (the post-merge main CI run is
    # retired), so releases arm on the 2h coalesce schedule and the two
    # gated dispatches only. Every armed tick cuts an annotated tag
    # (latest tag + 1) on origin/main plus the GitHub Release — coalesced
    # to <=1 per 2h (pub.dev rate-limits publishes, ~12/day; hit on
    # 2026-07-18). ZERO commits land on main: the retired flow pushed a
    # 4-file 'chore(release):' bot commit (pubspec.yaml, CHANGELOG.md,
    # flutter_app/pubspec.{yaml,lock}); the tag now drives everything and
    # CI stamps version/changelog into the STAGED publish tree at publish
    # time. The tag push rides the fa-release-bot App token because
    # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped publish/binaries
    # jobs (gh-1172); the App no longer needs the main-ruleset bypass (no
    # branch push), but remains the release-path actor (gh-1402).
    # Scheduled runs catch up commits that outpaced the coalesce window.
    # !cancelled() + explicit gate check: GitHub propagates "skipped"
    # TRANSITIVELY through an always()-job's needs graph. quality-gate uses
    # if: always() and its needs include path-gated legs (perf-gate etc.)
    # that skip on ordinary pushes — without !cancelled() this job was
    # force-skipped on EVERY run since the perf gate landed (fa#456),
    # silently killing auto-release for a week. The explicit result check
    # keeps the gate red-line: no release on a failed quality gate.
    # workflow_dispatch reaches this job ONLY through an explicit input gate
    # (gh-1172 round-2 BLOCK): this is the repo's dispatch-only CI — the SM
    # runs `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <pr-branch>` with no inputs, so a
    # bare dispatch arm would execute the dispatched (PR-head) ref's
    # auto_release.sh with the App's tag-push credentials. releaseDryRun
    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      (github.event_name == 'schedule'
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.releaseDryRun == true)
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.releaseDispatch == true)) &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    # Defense in depth (gh-1172 round-3 BLOCK): the tag push rides the
    # checkout App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs
    # write — on a dry-run dispatch of a PR head (AC1, any ref) that keeps
    # the job's own token read-only, leaving no write-capable credential in
    # the run.
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # Job-scoped App token (gh-1172 fix-contract item 1): minted per run,
      # expires with the job, never shared with other workflows.
      # NEVER minted on a dry-run dispatch: that arm fires on ANY ref, so the
      # credential must not exist in a run that executes the (possibly
      # untrusted) dispatched ref's auto_release.sh — "dry-run never pushes"
      # may not depend on the script under test honoring the flag. The real
      # arms (schedule, releaseDispatch — gh-1537 retired the main-push
      # trigger, so there is no push arm) see a non-true releaseDryRun
      # and mint as before.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        if: inputs.releaseDryRun != true
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write covers
          # the tag push + `gh release create`, nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token (not GITHUB_TOKEN) so the pushed tag triggers the
          # tag-scoped publish/binaries jobs — GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never
          # trigger downstream workflow runs.
          # Dry-run dispatch: the mint above is skipped, its outputs are
          # empty (falsy) and checkout falls back to the plain GITHUB_TOKEN
          # (read-only per the job permissions block).
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}

      - name: Cut release tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          RELEASE_DRY_RUN: ${{ github.event.inputs.releaseDryRun == 'true' && '1' || '0' }}
          # gh release create rides the App token (gh-1172): without an
          # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in auto_release.sh would be
          # a guaranteed silent no-op and the curated notes would never reach

# gh-1684 RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Pages deploy red since #1631 merged — `build/fa-extension.zip` fails the
"Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)" with TOTAL-1P +230.3% (35.7 MB →
117.9 MB first-party): the six vendored on-device-engine rows
(`vendor/litert/0.12.1/*.wasm`, `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-*.wasm`,
`vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs`) are brand-new tracked lines far above the
5%-of-first-party-TOTAL NEW-line share.

**Root cause**: The vendored engines are *intentional* (gh-1630 CWS policy:
the extension must carry no remote code), but the size floor
(`scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv`) was never reseeded to the post-#1631
shape, and the only place the regression could surface was the **deploy-time**
gate in `pages.yml` — after merge. There was no PR-time gate on the extension
zip at all (gh-1684 decision 2).

**Impact**: Every Pages run since #1631 fails → fa1.dev deploys blocked;
the extension zip stayed on the pre-#1631 baseline channel.

**Why the release leg looked green (AC5 divergence)**: the build-macos
extension gate was *also* red (same baseline, same 6 lines — see issue #1262's
sibling history and the absent `fa-extension.zip` in the v1.0.600 release
assets). The release *object* still went out with assets because the release
is created at tag-cut (`ci.yml` → `auto_release.sh`) and populated by sibling
jobs that never need the extension job (`release-macos` needs only
`[version, build-macos]`; the CLI and web-spa legs attach their assets
race-safe with `gh release create || true`). So a red extension job never
reddened the release. Additionally the two build legs were not even
build-identical: `pages.yml` pins Flutter `3.47.7` exactly while
`build-macos.yml` build-extension used unpinned `channel: stable`.

**Fix approach** (owner direction 2026-10-18, locked):

1. **Download channel**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GH Releases
   (`releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`). Site links switch
   (`site/index.html` ×5 href/text occurrences incl. the JSON-LD answer,
   `site/llms.txt` ×2). Pages stops building/copying/gating the zip.
2. **Gate moves to PR review time**: new `extension-size-gate` job in `ci.yml`
   builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7 — release-identical) on
   PRs/dispatches whose diff can move the zip, and fails the PR against the
   committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate`.
3. **Reseed** `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape
   (built locally with the pinned SDK, `--reseed`).
4. **Symmetry**: `build-macos.yml` build-extension pins Flutter 3.47.7
   (exactly like pages.yml did); both legs gate against the same committed
   baseline with the same `size_manifest.py check` invocation — one baseline,
   one enforcement rule.
5. **Never-again**: the notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs in
   pages.yml (baselines never committed since #1096) are removed rather than
   armed — deploy-time gates are the wrong layer (this bug is the proof).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug, not a returned ticket).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Per-artifact uncompressed size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1).

Emits the per-entry uncompressed size table (the issue's inventory format)
for a shipped artifact and fails the build when any tracked line regresses
beyond the budget (default +5%).

Usage:
  size_manifest.py emit   <artifact> [--min-bytes N]        # TSV to stdout
  size_manifest.py check  <artifact> --baseline FILE
                          [--budget-pct 5] [--init-if-missing]
                          [--manifest-out FILE] [--forbid REGEX]...
                          [--vendored REGEX]... [--strict-vendored]
  size_manifest.py selftest

`<artifact>` is a zip-family file (.zip/.ipa/.aab — uncompressed entry sizes
via zipfile) or a directory (tree of file sizes, for the web deploy root).

Manifest format (TSV; every row is `<bytes>\t<name>`, path-sorted. TOTAL
is an ordinary row — `<total_bytes>\tTOTAL` — and sorts among the paths;
do not rely on its position, the parser keys by name):
  <uncompressed_bytes>\t<path>
  <total_bytes>\tTOTAL

Rev-hash path normalization (#1431): a path segment of 20+ hex chars is
a content/rev-hash directory — the Flutter engine renderer artifacts
(canvaskit/skwasm) move under a new one on every 3.47.x patch drop while
the byte sizes stay identical. Both the artifact scan and the baseline
load collapse such segments to `<rev>` BEFORE diffing, so an engine rev
bump lands as an in-place UPDATE (the usual size-band compare) instead
of N brand-new heavyweight lines. Normalization is idempotent, so
pre-fix baselines carrying the literal rev hash migrate on load — no
baseline rewrite needed. Colliding normalized rows (two rev dirs in one
artifact, e.g. stale files) merge to the heavier one.

Gate semantics (`check`):
  - growth > budget%% on any baseline line or on the first-party TOTAL
    -> FAIL
  - NEW line heavier than 5%% of the baseline first-party TOTAL -> FAIL
    (catches re-adding removed weight, e.g. a dropped interpreter coming
    back — re-growth must be a conscious ack)
  - VENDORED carve-out (#1431): rows under a vendored prefix (default:
    the canvaskit/ engine-renderer subtree; extend with --vendored
    REGEX) are engine payload, not our growth — their breaches print
    ::warning and stay out of the failure count, and they are excluded
    from the TOTAL the budget compares (first-party TOTAL = TOTAL minus
    vendored rows). The engine reving is not the payload growing.
    --strict-vendored turns the carve-out off (everything gates again).
  - removed lines are improvements, reported only
  - --init-if-missing: no baseline file yet -> write it and pass with a
    loud notice (ratchet bootstrap; commit the file to arm the gate)
  - --reseed: overwrite an EXISTING baseline from this artifact and pass
    with a notice — the escape hatch for intentional growth; commit the
    rewritten file to make the new shape the floor
  - --forbid REGEX (repeatable): any manifest row whose path matches
    REGEX fails the check immediately, regardless of the +5% budget or
    the NEW-line share — the deny-list for evicted artifacts (a re-added
    5.6 MB fixture slips under both: NEW share is 5% of TOTAL). Enforced
    on check, --init-if-missing AND --reseed: re-admitting an artifact
    means dropping its --forbid flag, a conscious ack. The deny-list
    floor equals the tracking floor: sub-MIN_BYTES rows never enter the
    manifest.

CI escape hatch for intentional growth: re-run locally with the same
artifact and `--reseed`, commit the rewritten baseline.
"""

import argparse
import re
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

# Per-line tracking floor: smaller files are noise (thousands of them
# jitter by whole percentages); the TOTAL line covers their aggregate.
MIN_BYTES = 64 * 1024
# A brand-new tracked line heavier than this share of the old first-party
# TOTAL is re-growth, not rounding — fail it.
NEW_LINE_SHARE = 0.05
# A path segment of 20+ hex chars is a content/rev-hash directory: the
# Flutter engine renderer artifacts (canvaskit/skwasm wasm) ship under
# `canvaskit/<rev>/` and the rev changes on every 3.47.x patch drop
# (#1431). Collapsed to <rev> on BOTH the artifact scan and the baseline
# load so rev churn diffs as an in-place UPDATE, not N new lines.
REV_SEGMENT_RE = re.compile(r"(^|/)[0-9a-fA-F]{20,}(?=/|$)")
REV_PLACEHOLDER = "<rev>"
# Rows matching a vendored prefix are engine/vendor payload: their
# breaches warn instead of failing (#1431). The canvaskit/ subtree
# carries every engine renderer artifact (canvaskit/skwasm/wimp/
# webparagraph, chromium variant included). First-party paths —
# including our own shipped vendor/interpreters payload — keep the
# full rule.
VENDORED_DEFAULTS = [r"(^|/)canvaskit/"]


def normalize_revpaths(name: str) -> str:
    """Collapse 20+hex path segments (engine rev dirs) to <rev> (#1431)."""
    return REV_SEGMENT_RE.sub(lambda m: m.group(1) + REV_PLACEHOLDER, name)


def iter_sizes(artifact: Path):
    """Yield (path, uncompressed_bytes) for every file in the artifact."""
    if artifact.is_file():
        # zip-family: .zip / .ipa / .aab / .apk
        with zipfile.ZipFile(artifact) as zf:
            for info in zf.infolist():
                if info.is_dir():
                    continue
                yield info.filename.replace("\t", " "), info.file_size
        return
    if artifact.is_dir():
        for p in sorted(artifact.rglob("*")):
            if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink():
                yield p.relative_to(artifact).as_posix().replace("\t", " "), p.stat().st_size
        return
    raise SystemExit(f"size_manifest: artifact not found: {artifact}")


def build_manifest(artifact: Path, min_bytes: int) -> "dict[str, int]":
    sizes = dict(iter_sizes(artifact))
    manifest = {}
    for p, n in sizes.items():
        if n < min_bytes:
            continue
        key = normalize_revpaths(p)
        # Two rev dirs in one artifact (stale files) collide post-
        # normalization: keep the heavier row on both floor and current.
        if key not in manifest or manifest[key] < n:
            manifest[key] = n
    manifest["TOTAL"] = sum(sizes.values())
    return manifest


def fmt_table(manifest: "dict[str, int]") -> str:
    width = max((len(p) for p in manifest), default=5)
    lines = [f"{manifest[p]:>12}  {p.ljust(width)}" for p in sorted(manifest) if p != "TOTAL"]
    lines.append("-" * (width + 14))
    lines.append(f"{manifest['TOTAL']:>12}  TOTAL")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def load_baseline(path: Path) -> "dict[str, int]":
    baseline = {}
    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        size, _, name = line.partition("\t")
        key = normalize_revpaths(name)  # pre-fix literal-rev rows migrate
        if key not in baseline or baseline[key] < int(size):
            baseline[key] = int(size)
    if "TOTAL" not in baseline:
        raise SystemExit(f"size_manifest: baseline {path} has no TOTAL line")
    return baseline


def write_baseline(path: Path, manifest: "dict[str, int]") -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lines = [f"{manifest[p]}\t{p}" for p in sorted(manifest)]
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")


def check(artifact: Path, baseline_path: Path, budget_pct: float,
          init_if_missing: bool = False, reseed: bool = False,
          manifest_out=None, forbid=None, vendored=None,
          strict_vendored=False) -> int:
    manifest = build_manifest(artifact, MIN_BYTES)
    if manifest_out:
        write_baseline(manifest_out, manifest)

    # Deny-list (gh-1331 review): a returning evicted artifact fails the
    # gate in every mode — budget and NEW-line share both miss sub-5%
    # re-adds, so eviction is pinned by pattern, not by the floor.
    forbid_res = [re.compile(p) for p in forbid or []]
    if forbid_res:
        banned = [name for name in sorted(manifest)
                  if name != "TOTAL" and any(r.search(name) for r in forbid_res)]
        if banned:
            for name in banned:
                print(f"::error::size_manifest: FORBIDDEN row in {artifact}: "
                    …
