          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
        run: |
          # Per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget per line (issue
          # inventory format). First run seeds web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv
          # in the workspace (--init-if-missing) — the step below uploads
          # them as a ride-along artifact; commit them to arm the web
          # gates. The extension zip is gated against the committed
          # cut-shape baseline (same file the release gate in
          # build-macos.yml uses).
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/app \
            --baseline scripts/size_budget/web-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          if [ -d build/pages/root/outlook/app ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/root/outlook/app \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/outlook-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          fi
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv
          fi

      # The self-seeded baselines live only in this runner's workspace —
      # upload them so "commit it to arm the gate" is actually recoverable
      # (grab the artifact, commit the two TSVs).
      - name: Upload seeded size baselines (#1096 ratchet)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2

release:
    name: Auto-release (tag cut)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, quality-gate]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    # gh-1522: the release IS the tag. gh-1537: NO main-push arm — ci.yml
    # no longer triggers on pushes to main (the post-merge main CI run is
    # retired), so releases arm on the 2h coalesce schedule and the two
    # gated dispatches only. Every armed tick cuts an annotated tag
    # (latest tag + 1) on origin/main plus the GitHub Release — coalesced
    # to <=1 per 2h (pub.dev rate-limits publishes, ~12/day; hit on
    # 2026-07-18). ZERO commits land on main: the retired flow pushed a
    # 4-file 'chore(release):' bot commit (pubspec.yaml, CHANGELOG.md,
    # flutter_app/pubspec.{yaml,lock}); the tag now drives everything and
    # CI stamps version/changelog into the STAGED publish tree at publish
    # time. The tag push rides the fa-release-bot App token because
    # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped publish/binaries
    # jobs (gh-1172); the App no longer needs the main-ruleset bypass (no
    # branch push), but remains the release-path actor (gh-1402).
    # Scheduled runs catch up commits that outpaced the coalesce window.
    # !cancelled() + explicit gate check: GitHub propagates "skipped"
    # TRANSITIVELY through an always()-job's needs graph. quality-gate uses
    # if: always() and its needs include path-gated legs (perf-gate etc.)
    # that skip on ordinary pushes — without !cancelled() this job was
    # force-skipped on EVERY run since the perf gate landed (fa#456),
    # silently killing auto-release for a week. The explicit result check
    # keeps the gate red-line: no release on a failed quality gate.
    # workflow_dispatch reaches this job ONLY through an explicit input gate
    # (gh-1172 round-2 BLOCK): this is the repo's dispatch-only CI — the SM
    # runs `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <pr-branch>` with no inputs, so a
    # bare dispatch arm would execute the dispatched (PR-head) ref's
    # auto_release.sh with the App's tag-push credentials. releaseDryRun
    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      (github.event_name == 'schedule'
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.releaseDryRun == true)
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.releaseDispatch == true)) &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    # Defense in depth (gh-1172 round-3 BLOCK): the tag push rides the
    # checkout App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs
    # write — on a dry-run dispatch of a PR head (AC1, any ref) that keeps
    # the job's own token read-only, leaving no write-capable credential in
    # the run.
    permissions:
      contents: read

      # expires with the job, never shared with other workflows.
      # NEVER minted on a dry-run dispatch: that arm fires on ANY ref, so the
      # credential must not exist in a run that executes the (possibly
      # untrusted) dispatched ref's auto_release.sh — "dry-run never pushes"
      # may not depend on the script under test honoring the flag. The real
      # arms (schedule, releaseDispatch — gh-1537 retired the main-push
      # trigger, so there is no push arm) see a non-true releaseDryRun
      # and mint as before.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0

        if: inputs.releaseDryRun != true

          # the tag push + `gh release create`, nothing else.

{"content":"# gh-1684 RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Pages deploy red since #1631 merged — `build/fa-extension.zip` fails the
"Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)" with TOTAL-1P +230.3% (35.7 MB →
117.9 MB first-party): the six vendored on-device-engine rows
(`vendor/litert/0.12.1/*.wasm`, `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-*.wasm`,
`vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs`) are brand-new tracked lines far above the
5%-of-first-party-TOTAL NEW-line share.

**Root cause**: The vendored engines are *intentional* (gh-1630 CWS policy:
the extension must carry no remote code), but the size floor
(`scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv`) was never reseeded to the post-#1631
shape, and the only place the regression could surface was the **deploy-time**
gate in `pages.yml` — after merge. There was no PR-time gate on the extension
zip at all (gh-1684 decision 2).

**Impact**: Every Pages run since #1631 fails → fa1.dev deploys blocked;
the extension zip stayed on the pre-#1631 baseline channel.

**Why the release leg looked green (AC5 divergence)**: the build-macos
extension gate was *also* red (same baseline, same 6 lines — see issue #1262's
sibling history and the absent `fa-extension.zip` in the v1.0.600 release
assets). The release *object* still went out with assets because the release
is created at tag-cut (`ci.yml` → `auto_release.sh`) and populated by sibling
jobs that never need the extension job (`release-macos` needs only
`[version, build-macos]`; the CLI and web-spa legs attach their assets
race-safe with `gh release create || true`). So a red extension job never
reddened the release. Additionally the two build legs were not even
build-identical: `pages.yml` pins Flutter `3.47.7` exactly while
`build-macos.yml` build-extension used unpinned `channel: stable`.

**Fix approach** (owner direction 2026-10-18, locked):

1. **Download channel**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GH Releases
   (`releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`). Site links switch
   (`site/index.html` ×5 href/text occurrences incl. the JSON-LD answer,
   `site/llms.txt` ×2). Pages stops building/copying/gating the zip.
2. **Gate moves to PR review time**: new `extension-size-gate` job in `ci.yml`
   builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7 — release-identical) on
   PRs/dispatches whose diff can move the zip, and fails the PR against the
   committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate`.
3. **Reseed** `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape
   (built locally with the pinned SDK, `--reseed`).
4. **Symmetry**: `build-macos.yml` build-extension pins Flutter 3.47.7
   (exactly like pages.yml did); both legs gate against the same committed
   baseline with the same `size_manifest.py check` invocation — one baseline,
   one enforcement rule.
5. **Never-again**: the notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs in
   pages.yml (baselines never committed since #1096) are removed rather than
   armed — deploy-time gates are the wrong layer (this bug is the proof).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug, not a returned ticket).

release:
    name: Auto-release (tag cut)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, quality-gate]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    # gh-1522: the release IS the tag. gh-1537: NO main-push arm — ci.yml
    # no longer triggers on pushes to main (the post-merge main CI run is
    # retired), so releases arm on the 2h coalesce schedule and the two
    # gated dispatches only. Every armed tick cuts an annotated tag
    # (latest tag + 1) on origin/main plus the GitHub Release — coalesced
    # to <=1 per 2h (pub.dev rate-limits publishes, ~12/day; hit on
    # 2026-07-18). ZERO commits land on main: the retired flow pushed a
    # 4-file 'chore(release):' bot commit (pubspec.yaml, CHANGELOG.md,
    # flutter_app/pubspec.{yaml,lock}); the tag now drives everything and
    # CI stamps version/changelog into the STAGED publish tree at publish
    # time. The tag push rides the fa-release-bot App token because
    # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped publish/binaries
    # jobs (gh-1172); the App no longer needs the main-ruleset bypass (no
    # branch push), but remains the release-path actor (gh-1402).
    # Scheduled runs catch up commits that outpaced the coalesce window.
    # !cancelled() + explicit gate check: GitHub propagates "skipped"
    # TRANSITIVELY through an always()-job's needs graph. quality-gate uses
    # if: always() and its needs include path-gated legs (perf-gate etc.)
    # that skip on ordinary pushes — without !cancelled() this job was
    # force-skipped on EVERY run since the perf gate landed (fa#456),
    # silently killing auto-release for a week. The explicit result check
    # keeps the gate red-line: no release on a failed quality gate.
    # workflow_dispatch reaches this job ONLY through an explicit input gate
    # (gh-1172 round-2 BLOCK): this is the repo's dispatch-only CI — the SM
    # runs `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <pr-branch>` with no inputs, so a
    # bare dispatch arm would execute the dispatched (PR-head) ref's
    # auto_release.sh with the App's tag-push credentials. releaseDryRun
    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      (github.event_name == 'schedule'
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.releaseDryRun == true)
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.releaseDispatch == true)) &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    # Defense in depth (gh-1172 round-3 BLOCK): the tag push rides the
    # checkout App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs
    # write — on a dry-run dispatch of a PR head (AC1, any ref) that keeps
    # the job's own token read-only, leaving no write-capable credential in
    # the run.
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # Job-scoped App token (gh-1172 fix-contract item 1): minted per run,
      # expires with the job, never shared with other workflows.
      # NEVER minted on a dry-run dispatch: that arm fires on ANY ref, so the
      # credential must not exist in a run that executes the (possibly
      # untrusted) dispatched ref's auto_release.sh — "dry-run never pushes"
      # may not depend on the script under test honoring the flag. The real
      # arms (schedule, releaseDispatch — gh-1537 retired the main-push
      # trigger, so there is no push arm) see a non-true releaseDryRun
      # and mint as before.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        if: inputs.releaseDryRun != true
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): contents:write covers
          # the tag push + `gh release create`, nothing else.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # gh-1477: blobless — tag math reads commit metadata only.
          filter: blob:none
          # App token (not GITHUB_TOKEN) so the pushed tag triggers the
          # tag-scoped publish/binaries jobs — GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never
          # trigger downstream workflow runs.
          # Dry-run dispatch: the mint above is skipped, its outputs are
          # empty (falsy) and checkout falls back to the plain GITHUB_TOKEN
          # (read-only per the job permissions block).
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}

      - name: Cut release tag + GitHub Release
        env:
          RELEASE_DRY_RUN: ${{ github.event.inputs.releaseDryRun == 'true' && '1' || '0' }}
          # gh release create rides the App token (gh-1172): without an
          # explicit GH_TOKEN the create || true in auto_release.sh would be
          # a guaranteed silent no-op and the curated notes would never reach
          # the release object.
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}

{"content":"# gh-1684 RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Pages deploy red since #1631 merged — `build/fa-extension.zip` fails the
"Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)" with TOTAL-1P +230.3% (35.7 MB →
117.9 MB first-party): the six vendored on-device-engine rows
(`vendor/litert/0.12.1/*.wasm`, `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-*.wasm`,
`vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs`) are brand-new tracked lines far above the
5%-of-first-party-TOTAL NEW-line share.

**Root cause**: The vendored engines are *intentional* (gh-1630 CWS policy:
the extension must carry no remote code), but the size floor
(`scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv`) was never reseeded to the post-#1631
shape, and the only place the regression could surface was the **deploy-time**
gate in `pages.yml` — after merge. There was no PR-time gate on the extension
zip at all (gh-1684 decision 2).

**Impact**: Every Pages run since #1631 fails → fa1.dev deploys blocked;
the extension zip stayed on the pre-#1631 baseline channel.

**Why the release leg looked green (AC5 divergence)**: the build-macos
extension gate was *also* red (same baseline, same 6 lines — see issue #1262's
sibling history and the absent `fa-extension.zip` in the v1.0.600 release
assets). The release *object* still went out with assets because the release
is created at tag-cut (`ci.yml` → `auto_release.sh`) and populated by sibling
jobs that never need the extension job (`release-macos` needs only
`[version, build-macos]`; the CLI and web-spa legs attach their assets
race-safe with `gh release create || true`). So a red extension job never
reddened the release. Additionally the two build legs were not even
build-identical: `pages.yml` pins Flutter `3.47.7` exactly while
`build-macos.yml` build-extension used unpinned `channel: stable`.

**Fix approach** (owner direction 2026-10-18, locked):

1. **Download channel**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GH Releases
   (`releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`). Site links switch
   (`site/index.html` ×5 href/text occurrences incl. the JSON-LD answer,
   `site/llms.txt` ×2). Pages stops building/copying/gating the zip.
2. **Gate moves to PR review time**: new `extension-size-gate` job in `ci.yml`
   builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7 — release-identical) on
   PRs/dispatches whose diff can move the zip, and fails the PR against the
   committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate`.
3. **Reseed** `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape
   (built locally with the pinned SDK, `--reseed`).
4. **Symmetry**: `build-macos.yml` build-extension pins Flutter 3.47.7
   (exactly like pages.yml did); both legs gate against the same committed
   baseline with the same `size_manifest.py check` invocation — one baseline,
   one enforcement rule.
5. **Never-again**: the notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs in
   pages.yml (baselines never committed since #1096) are removed rather than
   armed — deploy-time gates are the wrong layer (this bug is the proof).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug, not a returned ticket).

      - name: Upload seeded size baselines (#1096 ratchet)

Two honest outcomes: (a) real regrowth → identify the import/dependency that got pulled into the web build and cut or lazy-load it; (b) legitimate growth (new feature) → reseed with a written justification in the PR, per the floor policy.

- AC1: growth root-named in this issue (commit + mechanism) before any baseline change.
- AC2: pages.yml and build-macos size gates green on main — either by cutting the regrowth or by a justified reseed PR that links this analysis.

Now after #1631 both Pages and presumably the release extension gate fail again (the ticket evidence: Pages fails; the release leg likely also red — "fa-extension.zip not in GH release assets v1.0.600" suggests the extension job failed so no zip attached, while release created by other jobs).

Enough investigation. The AC5 answer: 
- Both gates were failing; the release leg isn't actually green — the daily cli leg red → self-filed issue; the release OBJECT still appears "green"/populated because tag-cut (ci.yml auto_release.sh) creates the release and sibling asset jobs (CLI bundles, web-spa, mac DMGs via release-macos needing only [version, build-macos]) attach assets without the extension job. fa-extension.zip is absent from v1.0.600 assets because the extension job died at the gate.
- Plus a build-flag asymetry: build-extension uses unpinned `channel: stable` vs Pages' exact 3.47.7 — engine rev differences change canvaskit entries.

Now, the plan. Also AC4: web-app.tsv + outlook-app.tsv baselines committed and armed, or legs removed. The baselines were never committed (notice-only). Options: (a) seed them from a local build and commit, arming the gates in Pages; (b) remove the legs. The owner decision says "arm or remove". Since Pages stops failing... the web-app gate in pages.yml still runs (--init-if-missing). Commiting a baseline I can't generate faithfully locally is risky: the web-app baseline depends on flutter build of flutter_app (I CAN build it locally — flutter 3.47.7 available!). But sizes of build/pages/app include the flutter web build output — deterministic-ish given pinned flutter. However the baseline also depends on the app build flags in pages.yml (`--base-href /app/`), same as I can run locally. Risky but doable. Minimal, safe approach satisfying AC4: remove the notice-only gates from pages.yml (they've never gated anything; their seeding upload step becomes obsolete) — "or the legs removed". Note build-web uses `3.47.x` (wildcard) while pages.yml pins 3.47.7 exact (#1431 rationale: wildcard re-resolves new engine builds → canvaskit rev dir moves → gate false-reds; normalization handles rev dirs now though).

Now design the fix:

## Changes

### 1. pages.yml
- Remove the extension zip copy in "Asemble Pages artifact".
- Remove the fa-extension.zip gate leg from "Size manifest + budget gate" step.
- AC4: remove web-app/outlook-app notice-only gates? The step currently seeds baselines via --init-if-missing and uploads them. Decision: REMOVE those legs from Pages (per decision 5 option "removed")... but wait — do we want the web app and outlook app size gates anywhere? The owner's decision 5 says arm OR remove. Given the extension gate moves to PR review, moving the web-app + outlook-app gates to PR CI too would be consistent and keeps protection. But that adds scope: need a PR job that builds the web app AND the outlook add-in on path trigger. There's already office-addin-suite building the outlook add-in on PRs! I could arm the outlook gate there. And web-app gate could ride build-web... but build-web builds debug (`flutter build web` without --release and without /app/ base-href, and the baseline must match the release shape built in Pages). Size baseline from a debug build ≠ release build. Risky to arm against mismatched artifact.

The safest interpretation that satisfies AC4 literally: remove the notice-only legs from pages.yml entirely (they never gated; their baselines never committed). The comment in the gate step says "commit them to arm the web gates" — but owner decision 5 says "arm or remove". Removing = deleting the two `size_manifest.py check ... --init-if-missing` invocations + the baseline-upload step. Then web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv never get seeded; the scripts/size_budget dir keeps fa-extension.tsv, fa-ios.tsv, fa-macos-arm64.tsv.

Hmm wait, but then web app size is completely ungated. Before #1096 it was ungated too; this is acceptable per owner decision ("or the legs removed").

Actually — hold on. Let me reconsider: "arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates". I'll go with remove, documenting rationale in the PR notes: the deploy-time gate is the wrong layer (this bug is the proof), and a faithfully-matching baseline for the release web app can be added to the PR gate later; removing avoids shipping a baseline generated from a differently-flaged build. Actually, wait — maybe arming is not that hard: I could build the web app locally exactly as pages.yml does (flutter build web --release --base-href /app/, pinned 3.47.7) and commit web-app.tsv, then the pages.yml gate becomes armed against the deploy artifact itself (same runner type, same flags). The outlook app: build_office_addin.sh locally — needs office build; let me check what that script needs. That's heavier.

Let me weigh: committing an armed baseline that was generated on THIS runner — the Pages runner builds with same flutter 3.47.7 pinned and same flags; entry sizes should be byte-identical (deterministic build? canvaskit rev normalized; fonts/assets deterministic; main.dart.js compiled by same SDK — should be identical given same inputs). {"content":"# gh-1684 RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Pages deploy red since #1631 merged — `build/fa-extension.zip` fails the
"Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)" with TOTAL-1P +230.3% (35.7 MB →
117.9 MB first-party): the six vendored on-device-engine rows
(`vendor/litert/0.12.1/*.wasm`, `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-*.wasm`,
`vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs`) are brand-new tracked lines far above the
5%-of-first-party-TOTAL NEW-line share.

**Root cause**: The vendored engines are *intentional* (gh-1630 CWS policy:
the extension must carry no remote code), but the size floor
(`scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv`) was never reseeded to the post-#1631
shape, and the only place the regression could surface was the **deploy-time**
gate in `pages.yml` — after merge. There was no PR-time gate on the extension
zip at all (gh-1684 decision 2).

**Impact**: Every Pages run since #1631 fails → fa1.dev deploys blocked;
the extension zip stayed on the pre-#1631 baseline channel.

**Why the release leg looked green (AC5 divergence)**: the build-macos
extension gate was *also* red (same baseline, same 6 lines — see issue #1262's
sibling history and the absent `fa-extension.zip` in the v1.0.600 release
assets). The release *object* still went out with assets because the release
is created at tag-cut (`ci.yml` → `auto_release.sh`) and populated by sibling
jobs that never need the extension job (`release-macos` needs only
`[version, build-macos]`; the CLI and web-spa legs attach their assets
race-safe with `gh release create || true`). So a red extension job never
reddened the release. Additionally the two build legs were not even
build-identical: `pages.yml` pins Flutter `3.47.7` exactly while
`build-macos.yml` build-extension used unpinned `channel: stable`.

**Fix approach** (owner direction 2026-10-18, locked):

1. **Download channel**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GH Releases
   (`releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`). Site links switch
   (`site/index.html` ×5 href/text occurrences incl. the JSON-LD answer,
   `site/llms.txt` ×2). Pages stops building/copying/gating the zip.
2. **Gate moves to PR review time**: new `extension-size-gate` job in `ci.yml`
   builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7 — release-identical) on
   PRs/dispatches whose diff can move the zip, and fails the PR against the
   committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate`.
3. **Reseed** `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape
   (built locally with the pinned SDK, `--reseed`).
4. **Symmetry**: `build-macos.yml` build-extension pins Flutter 3.47.7
   (exactly like pages.yml did); both legs gate against the same committed
   baseline with the same `size_manifest.py check` invocation — one baseline,
   one enforcement rule.
5. **Never-again**: the notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs in
   pages.yml (baselines never committed since #1096) are removed rather than
   armed — deploy-time gates are the wrong layer (this bug is the proof).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug, not a returned ticket).

170:      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
193:      - name: Upload seeded size baselines (#1096 ratchet)

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BUILD_ID: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Bust the Flutter demo app's entry scripts so browsers never load a
          # stale flutter_bootstrap.js / helper bundle after a new deploy.
          sed -i -E 's|src="([^\"]+)"|src="\1?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/app/index.html
          # Bust the landing page's own CSS/JS and the demo-app iframe/link.
          sed -i -E 's|href="styles\.css"|href="styles.css?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
        run: |
          # Per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget per line (issue
          # inventory format). First run seeds web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv
          # in the workspace (--init-if-missing) — the step below uploads
          # them as a ride-along artifact; commit them to arm the web
          # gates. The extension zip is gated against the committed
          # cut-shape baseline (same file the release gate in
          # build-macos.yml uses).
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/app \
            --baseline scripts/size_budget/web-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          if [ -d build/pages/root/outlook/app ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/root/outlook/app \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/outlook-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          fi
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv
          fi

      # The self-seeded baselines live only in this runner's workspace —
      # upload them so "commit it to arm the gate" is actually recoverable
      # (grab the artifact, commit the two TSVs).
      - name: Upload seeded size baselines (#1096 ratchet)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: size-baselines
          path: scripts/size_budget/*.tsv
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9 # v5.0.0
        with:
          path: build/pages/root

      # Gate the deploy on a real-browser boot smoke: serve the assembled
      # artifact and drive headless Chromium — the app must mount and run
      # Dart main() with zero console errors. Dart tests cannot catch
      # runtime JS-interop crashes (once shipped: the extension probe threw
      # a null-check on every normal page); this can and did.
      - name: Web boot smoke (headless Chromium)
        working-directory: build/pages/root
        run: |
          python3 -m http.server 8788 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
          SERVER_PID=$!
          trap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

{"content":"# gh-1684 RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Pages deploy red since #1631 merged — `build/fa-extension.zip` fails the
"Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)" with TOTAL-1P +230.3% (35.7 MB →
117.9 MB first-party): the six vendored on-device-engine rows
(`vendor/litert/0.12.1/*.wasm`, `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-*.wasm`,
`vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs`) are brand-new tracked lines far above the
5%-of-first-party-TOTAL NEW-line share.

**Root cause**: The vendored engines are *intentional* (gh-1630 CWS policy:
the extension must carry no remote code), but the size floor
(`scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv`) was never reseeded to the post-#1631
shape, and the only place the regression could surface was the **deploy-time**
gate in `pages.yml` — after merge. There was no PR-time gate on the extension
zip at all (gh-1684 decision 2).

**Impact**: Every Pages run since #1631 fails → fa1.dev deploys blocked;
the extension zip stayed on the pre-#1631 baseline channel.

**Why the release leg looked green (AC5 divergence)**: the build-macos
extension gate was *also* red (same baseline, same 6 lines — see issue #1262's
sibling history and the absent `fa-extension.zip` in the v1.0.600 release
assets). The release *object* still went out with assets because the release
is created at tag-cut (`ci.yml` → `auto_release.sh`) and populated by sibling
jobs that never need the extension job (`release-macos` needs only
`[version, build-macos]`; the CLI and web-spa legs attach their assets
race-safe with `gh release create || true`). So a red extension job never
reddened the release. Additionally the two build legs were not even
build-identical: `pages.yml` pins Flutter `3.47.7` exactly while
`build-macos.yml` build-extension used unpinned `channel: stable`.

**Fix approach** (owner direction 2026-10-18, locked):

1. **Download channel**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GH Releases
   (`releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`). Site links switch
   (`site/index.html` ×5 href/text occurrences incl. the JSON-LD answer,
   `site/llms.txt` ×2). Pages stops building/copying/gating the zip.
2. **Gate moves to PR review time**: new `extension-size-gate` job in `ci.yml`
   builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7 — release-identical) on
   PRs/dispatches whose diff can move the zip, and fails the PR against the
   committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate`.
3. **Reseed** `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape
   (built locally with the pinned SDK, `--reseed`).
4. **Symmetry**: `build-macos.yml` build-extension pins Flutter 3.47.7
   (exactly like pages.yml did); both legs gate against the same committed
   baseline with the same `size_manifest.py check` invocation — one baseline,
   one enforcement rule.
5. **Never-again**: the notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs in
   pages.yml (baselines never committed since #1096) are removed rather than
   armed — deploy-time gates are the wrong layer (this bug is the proof).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug, not a returned ticket).

170:      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BUILD_ID: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Bust the Flutter demo app's entry scripts so browsers never load a
          # stale flutter_bootstrap.js / helper bundle after a new deploy.
          sed -i -E 's|src="([^\"]+)"|src="\1?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/app/index.html
          # Bust the landing page's own CSS/JS and the demo-app iframe/link.
          sed -i -E 's|href="styles\.css"|href="styles.css?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
        run: |
          # Per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget per line (issue
          # inventory format). First run seeds web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv
          # in the workspace (--init-if-missing) — the step below uploads
          # them as a ride-along artifact; commit them to arm the web
          # gates. The extension zip is gated against the committed
          # cut-shape baseline (same file the release gate in
          # build-macos.yml uses).
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/app \
            --baseline scripts/size_budget/web-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          if [ -d build/pages/root/outlook/app ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/root/outlook/app \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/outlook-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          fi
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv
          fi

      # The self-seeded baselines live only in this runner's workspace —
      # upload them so "commit it to arm the gate" is actually recoverable
      # (grab the artifact, commit the two TSVs).
      - name: Upload seeded size baselines (#1096 ratchet)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: size-baselines
          path: scripts/size_budget/*.tsv
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9 # v5.0.0
        with:
          path: build/pages/root

      # Gate the deploy on a real-browser boot smoke: serve the assembled
      # artifact and drive headless Chromium — the app must mount and run
      # Dart main() with zero console errors. Dart tests cannot catch
      # runtime JS-interop crashes (once shipped: the extension probe threw
      # a null-check on every normal page); this can and did.
      - name: Web boot smoke (headless Chromium)
        working-directory: build/pages/root
        run: |
          python3 -m http.server 8788 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
          SERVER_PID=$!
          trap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

build-web:
    name: Build web (debug)

    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      # Pinned to the same SDK as the release path (#281): 3.47.x. The
      # action's cache key embeds the resolved SDK version, so an SDK bump
      # in a PR never restores a poisoned cache (E1).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset

      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

        # E3: warnings (including the Wasm dry-run diagnostics) are allowed;

{"content":"# gh-1684 RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Pages deploy red since #1631 merged — `build/fa-extension.zip` fails the
"Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)" with TOTAL-1P +230.3% (35.7 MB →
117.9 MB first-party): the six vendored on-device-engine rows
(`vendor/litert/0.12.1/*.wasm`, `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-*.wasm`,
`vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs`) are brand-new tracked lines far above the
5%-of-first-party-TOTAL NEW-line share.

**Root cause**: The vendored engines are *intentional* (gh-1630 CWS policy:
the extension must carry no remote code), but the size floor
(`scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv`) was never reseeded to the post-#1631
shape, and the only place the regression could surface was the **deploy-time**
gate in `pages.yml` — after merge. There was no PR-time gate on the extension
zip at all (gh-1684 decision 2).

**Impact**: Every Pages run since #1631 fails → fa1.dev deploys blocked;
the extension zip stayed on the pre-#1631 baseline channel.

**Why the release leg looked green (AC5 divergence)**: the build-macos
extension gate was *also* red (same baseline, same 6 lines — see issue #1262's
sibling history and the absent `fa-extension.zip` in the v1.0.600 release
assets). The release *object* still went out with assets because the release
is created at tag-cut (`ci.yml` → `auto_release.sh`) and populated by sibling
jobs that never need the extension job (`release-macos` needs only
`[version, build-macos]`; the CLI and web-spa legs attach their assets
race-safe with `gh release create || true`). So a red extension job never
reddened the release. Additionally the two build legs were not even
build-identical: `pages.yml` pins Flutter `3.47.7` exactly while
`build-macos.yml` build-extension used unpinned `channel: stable`.

**Fix approach** (owner direction 2026-10-18, locked):

1. **Download channel**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GH Releases
   (`releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`). Site links switch
   (`site/index.html` ×5 href/text occurrences incl. the JSON-LD answer,
   `site/llms.txt` ×2). Pages stops building/copying/gating the zip.
2. **Gate moves to PR review time**: new `extension-size-gate` job in `ci.yml`
   builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7 — release-identical) on
   PRs/dispatches whose diff can move the zip, and fails the PR against the
   committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate`.
3. **Reseed** `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape
   (built locally with the pinned SDK, `--reseed`).
4. **Symmetry**: `build-macos.yml` build-extension pins Flutter 3.47.7
   (exactly like pages.yml did); both legs gate against the same committed
   baseline with the same `size_manifest.py check` invocation — one baseline,
   one enforcement rule.
5. **Never-again**: the notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs in
   pages.yml (baselines never committed since #1096) are removed rather than
   armed — deploy-time gates are the wrong layer (this bug is the proof).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug, not a returned ticket).

170:      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BUILD_ID: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Bust the Flutter demo app's entry scripts so browsers never load a
          # stale flutter_bootstrap.js / helper bundle after a new deploy.
          sed -i -E 's|src="([^\"]+)"|src="\1?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/app/index.html
          # Bust the landing page's own CSS/JS and the demo-app iframe/link.
          sed -i -E 's|href="styles\.css"|href="styles.css?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
        run: |
          # Per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget per line (issue
          # inventory format). First run seeds web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv
          # in the workspace (--init-if-missing) — the step below uploads
          # them as a ride-along artifact; commit them to arm the web
          # gates. The extension zip is gated against the committed
          # cut-shape baseline (same file the release gate in
          # build-macos.yml uses).
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/app \
            --baseline scripts/size_budget/web-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          if [ -d build/pages/root/outlook/app ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/root/outlook/app \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/outlook-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          fi
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv
          fi

      # The self-seeded baselines live only in this runner's workspace —
      # upload them so "commit it to arm the gate" is actually recoverable
      # (grab the artifact, commit the two TSVs).
      - name: Upload seeded size baselines (#1096 ratchet)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: size-baselines
          path: scripts/size_budget/*.tsv
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9 # v5.0.0
        with:
          path: build/pages/root

      # Gate the deploy on a real-browser boot smoke: serve the assembled
      # artifact and drive headless Chromium — the app must mount and run
      # Dart main() with zero console errors. Dart tests cannot catch
      # runtime JS-interop crashes (once shipped: the extension probe threw
      # a null-check on every normal page); this can and did.
      - name: Web boot smoke (headless Chromium)
        working-directory: build/pages/root
        run: |
          python3 -m http.server 8788 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
          SERVER_PID=$!
          trap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

{"content":"# gh-1684 RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Pages deploy red since #1631 merged — `build/fa-extension.zip` fails the
"Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)" with TOTAL-1P +230.3% (35.7 MB →
117.9 MB first-party): the six vendored on-device-engine rows
(`vendor/litert/0.12.1/*.wasm`, `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-*.wasm`,
`vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs`) are brand-new tracked lines far above the
5%-of-first-party-TOTAL NEW-line share.

**Root cause**: The vendored engines are *intentional* (gh-1630 CWS policy:
the extension must carry no remote code), but the size floor
(`scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv`) was never reseeded to the post-#1631
shape, and the only place the regression could surface was the **deploy-time**
gate in `pages.yml` — after merge. There was no PR-time gate on the extension
zip at all (gh-1684 decision 2).

**Impact**: Every Pages run since #1631 fails → fa1.dev deploys blocked;
the extension zip stayed on the pre-#1631 baseline channel.

**Why the release leg looked green (AC5 divergence)**: the build-macos
extension gate was *also* red (same baseline, same 6 lines — see issue #1262's
sibling history and the absent `fa-extension.zip` in the v1.0.600 release
assets). The release *object* still went out with assets because the release
is created at tag-cut (`ci.yml` → `auto_release.sh`) and populated by sibling
jobs that never need the extension job (`release-macos` needs only
`[version, build-macos]`; the CLI and web-spa legs attach their assets
race-safe with `gh release create || true`). So a red extension job never
reddened the release. Additionally the two build legs were not even
build-identical: `pages.yml` pins Flutter `3.47.7` exactly while
`build-macos.yml` build-extension used unpinned `channel: stable`.

**Fix approach** (owner direction 2026-10-18, locked):

1. **Download channel**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GH Releases
   (`releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`). Site links switch
   (`site/index.html` ×5 href/text occurrences incl. the JSON-LD answer,
   `site/llms.txt` ×2). Pages stops building/copying/gating the zip.
2. **Gate moves to PR review time**: new `extension-size-gate` job in `ci.yml`
   builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7 — release-identical) on
   PRs/dispatches whose diff can move the zip, and fails the PR against the
   committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate`.
3. **Reseed** `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape
   (built locally with the pinned SDK, `--reseed`).
4. **Symmetry**: `build-macos.yml` build-extension pins Flutter 3.47.7
   (exactly like pages.yml did); both legs gate against the same committed
   baseline with the same `size_manifest.py check` invocation — one baseline,
   one enforcement rule.
5. **Never-again**: the notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs in
   pages.yml (baselines never committed since #1096) are removed rather than
   armed — deploy-time gates are the wrong layer (this bug is the proof).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug, not a returned ticket).

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BUILD_ID: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Bust the Flutter demo app's entry scripts so browsers never load a
          # stale flutter_bootstrap.js / helper bundle after a new deploy.
          sed -i -E 's|src="([^\"]+)"|src="\1?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/app/index.html
          # Bust the landing page's own CSS/JS and the demo-app iframe/link.
          sed -i -E 's|href="styles\.css"|href="styles.css?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
        run: |
          # Per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget per line (issue
          # inventory format). First run seeds web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv
          # in the workspace (--init-if-missing) — the step below uploads
          # them as a ride-along artifact; commit them to arm the web
          # gates. The extension zip is gated against the committed
          # cut-shape baseline (same file the release gate in
          # build-macos.yml uses).
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/app \
            --baseline scripts/size_budget/web-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          if [ -d build/pages/root/outlook/app ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/root/outlook/app \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/outlook-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          fi
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv
          fi

      # The self-seeded baselines live only in this runner's workspace —
      # upload them so "commit it to arm the gate" is actually recoverable
      # (grab the artifact, commit the two TSVs).
      - name: Upload seeded size baselines (#1096 ratchet)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: size-baselines
          path: scripts/size_budget/*.tsv
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9 # v5.0.0

      # Dart main() with zero console errors. Dart tests cannot catch
      # runtime JS-interop crashes (once shipped: the extension probe threw
      # a null-check on every normal page); this can and did.
      - name: Web boot smoke (headless Chromium)
        working-directory: build/pages/root
        run: |
          python3 -m http.server 8788 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
          SERVER_PID=$!
          trap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

Decision: REMOVE those legs from Pages (per decision 5 option "removed")... but wait — do we want the web app and outlook app size gates anywhere? The owner's decision 5 says arm OR remove. Given the extension gate moves to PR review, moving the web-app + outlook-app gates to PR CI too would be consistent and keeps protection. But that adds scope: need a PR job that builds the web app AND the outlook add-in on path trigger. There's already office-addin-suite building the outlook add-in on PRs! I could arm the outlook gate there. And web-app gate could ride build-web... but build-web builds debug (`flutter build web` without --release and without /app/ base-href, and the baseline must match the release shape built in Pages). Size baseline from a debug build ≠ release build. Risky to arm against mismatched artifact.

The safest interpretation that satisfies AC4 literally: remove the notice-only legs from pages.yml entirely (they never gated; their baselines never committed). The comment in the gate step says "commit them to arm the web gates" — but owner decision 5 says "arm or remove". Removing = deleting the two `size_manifest.py check ... --init-if-missing` invocations + the baseline-upload step. Then web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv never get seeded; the scripts/size_budget dir keeps fa-extension.tsv, fa-ios.tsv, fa-macos-arm64.tsv.

Hmm wait, but then web app size is completely ungated. Before #1096 it was ungated too; this is acceptable per owner decision ("or the legs removed").

Actually — hold on. Let me reconsider: "arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates". I'll go with remove, documenting rationale in the PR notes: the deploy-time gate is the wrong layer (this bug is the proof), and a faithfully-matching baseline for the release web app can be added to the PR gate later; removing avoids shipping a baseline generated from a differently-flaged build. The outlook app: build_office_addin.sh locally — needs office build; let me check what that script needs. That's heavier.

Let me weigh: committing an armed baseline that was generated on THIS runner — the Pages runner builds with same flutter 3.47.7 pinned and same flags; entry sizes should be byte-identical (deterministic build? canvaskit rev normalized; fonts/assets deterministic; main.dart.js compiled by same SDK — should be identical given same inputs). The risk is low and arming > removing for protection. But the outlook build needs office_addin stuff + FA_HOST=office; script also validates manifest etc. Let me check if it runs on linux easily.

Time budget: building flutter web app locally takes ~2-5 min. Extension zip build with vendor fetch: fetch_vendor_assets.sh downloads ~100MB+ from CDN — feasible if network allows. Let me try the extension build first since the reseed is mandatory (decision 3).

Let me also review AC3: "a vendor-bump PR without a reseed fails red at review time" — the PR gate must trigger on vendor.lock.json changes and extension source changes, and the check must fail when sizes exceed baseline. With size_manifest check (no --init-if-missing) it will.

(app embed changes sizes), flutter_app/** (panel app sources affect main.dart.js size!), lib/** (agent.js compiles lib code!), pubspec.lock (root — affects dart compile). Hmm. The zip contains: manifest, sw/agent.js (compiled from lib + browser_ext/dart), panel app (flutter web build of flutter_app). Pages already pays this on every site-touching push.

To keep it "fail the PR on extension-touching difs" per the ticket: "build the extension zip ... on PRs that touch extension sources/vendor". So paths: browser_ext/**, scripts/build_browser_ext.sh, scripts/fetch_vendor_assets.sh, scripts/stage_extension_panel.py, browser_ext/vendor.lock.json (inside browser_ext/** anyway), vendor/** (vendored engines?), .github/workflows/ci.yml (the gate itself), scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv (a reseed PR must run the gate to prove the baseline matches!). I'll put it in the platform_red group alongside office-addin-suite (a build leg), and echo/report it.

{"content":"# gh-1684 RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Pages deploy red since #1631 merged — `build/fa-extension.zip` fails the
"Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)" with TOTAL-1P +230.3% (35.7 MB →
117.9 MB first-party): the six vendored on-device-engine rows
(`vendor/litert/0.12.1/*.wasm`, `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-*.wasm`,
`vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs`) are brand-new tracked lines far above the
5%-of-first-party-TOTAL NEW-line share.

**Root cause**: The vendored engines are *intentional* (gh-1630 CWS policy:
the extension must carry no remote code), but the size floor
(`scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv`) was never reseeded to the post-#1631
shape, and the only place the regression could surface was the **deploy-time**
gate in `pages.yml` — after merge. There was no PR-time gate on the extension
zip at all (gh-1684 decision 2).

**Impact**: Every Pages run since #1631 fails → fa1.dev deploys blocked;
the extension zip stayed on the pre-#1631 baseline channel.

**Why the release leg looked green (AC5 divergence)**: the build-macos
extension gate was *also* red (same baseline, same 6 lines — see issue #1262's
sibling history and the absent `fa-extension.zip` in the v1.0.600 release
assets). The release *object* still went out with assets because the release
is created at tag-cut (`ci.yml` → `auto_release.sh`) and populated by sibling
jobs that never need the extension job (`release-macos` needs only
`[version, build-macos]`; the CLI and web-spa legs attach their assets
race-safe with `gh release create || true`). So a red extension job never
reddened the release. Additionally the two build legs were not even
build-identical: `pages.yml` pins Flutter `3.47.7` exactly while
`build-macos.yml` build-extension used unpinned `channel: stable`.

**Fix approach** (owner direction 2026-10-18, locked):

1. **Download channel**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GH Releases
   (`releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`). Site links switch
   (`site/index.html` ×5 href/text occurrences incl. the JSON-LD answer,
   `site/llms.txt` ×2). Pages stops building/copying/gating the zip.
2. **Gate moves to PR review time**: new `extension-size-gate` job in `ci.yml`
   builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7 — release-identical) on
   PRs/dispatches whose diff can move the zip, and fails the PR against the
   committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate`.
3. **Reseed** `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape
   (built locally with the pinned SDK, `--reseed`).
4. **Symmetry**: `build-macos.yml` build-extension pins Flutter 3.47.7
   (exactly like pages.yml did); both legs gate against the same committed
   baseline with the same `size_manifest.py check` invocation — one baseline,
   one enforcement rule.
5. **Never-again**: the notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs in
   pages.yml (baselines never committed since #1096) are removed rather than
   armed — deploy-time gates are the wrong layer (this bug is the proof).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug, not a returned ticket).
","path":"outputs/rca.md"}

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BUILD_ID: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Bust the Flutter demo app's entry scripts so browsers never load a
          # stale flutter_bootstrap.js / helper bundle after a new deploy.
          sed -i -E 's|src="([^\"]+)"|src="\1?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/app/index.html
          # Bust the landing page's own CSS/JS and the demo-app iframe/link.
          sed -i -E 's|href="styles\.css"|href="styles.css?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
        run: |
          # Per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget per line (issue
          # inventory format). First run seeds web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv
          # in the workspace (--init-if-missing) — the step below uploads
          # them as a ride-along artifact; commit them to arm the web
          # gates. The extension zip is gated against the committed
          # cut-shape baseline (same file the release gate in
          # build-macos.yml uses).
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/app \
            --baseline scripts/size_budget/web-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          if [ -d build/pages/root/outlook/app ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/root/outlook/app \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/outlook-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          fi
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv
          fi

      # The self-seeded baselines live only in this runner's workspace —
      # upload them so "commit it to arm the gate" is actually recoverable
      # (grab the artifact, commit the two TSVs).
      - name: Upload seeded size baselines (#1096 ratchet)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: size-baselines
          path: scripts/size_budget/*.tsv

      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9 # v5.0.0

      - name: Web boot smoke (headless Chromium)

        run: |
          python3 -m http.server 8788 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
          SERVER_PID=$!
          trap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

{"content":"# gh-1684 RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Pages deploy red since #1631 merged — `build/fa-extension.zip` fails the
"Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)" with TOTAL-1P +230.3% (35.7 MB →
117.9 MB first-party): the six vendored on-device-engine rows
(`vendor/litert/0.12.1/*.wasm`, `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-*.wasm`,
`vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs`) are brand-new tracked lines far above the
5%-of-first-party-TOTAL NEW-line share.

**Root cause**: The vendored engines are *intentional* (gh-1630 CWS policy:
the extension must carry no remote code), but the size floor
(`scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv`) was never reseeded to the post-#1631
shape, and the only place the regression could surface was the **deploy-time**
gate in `pages.yml` — after merge. There was no PR-time gate on the extension
zip at all (gh-1684 decision 2).

**Impact**: Every Pages run since #1631 fails → fa1.dev deploys blocked;
the extension zip stayed on the pre-#1631 baseline channel.

**Why the release leg looked green (AC5 divergence)**: the build-macos
extension gate was *also* red (same baseline, same 6 lines — see issue #1262's
sibling history and the absent `fa-extension.zip` in the v1.0.600 release
assets). The release *object* still went out with assets because the release
is created at tag-cut (`ci.yml` → `auto_release.sh`) and populated by sibling
jobs that never need the extension job (`release-macos` needs only
`[version, build-macos]`; the CLI and web-spa legs attach their assets
race-safe with `gh release create || true`). So a red extension job never
reddened the release. Additionally the two build legs were not even
build-identical: `pages.yml` pins Flutter `3.47.7` exactly while
`build-macos.yml` build-extension used unpinned `channel: stable`.

**Fix approach** (owner direction 2026-10-18, locked):

1. **Download channel**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GH Releases
   (`releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`). Site links switch
   (`site/index.html` ×5 href/text occurrences incl. the JSON-LD answer,
   `site/llms.txt` ×2). Pages stops building/copying/gating the zip.
2. **Gate moves to PR review time**: new `extension-size-gate` job in `ci.yml`
   builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7 — release-identical) on
   PRs/dispatches whose diff can move the zip, and fails the PR against the
   committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate`.
3. **Reseed** `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape
   (built locally with the pinned SDK, `--reseed`).
4. **Symmetry**: `build-macos.yml` build-extension pins Flutter 3.47.7
   (exactly like pages.yml did); both legs gate against the same committed
   baseline with the same `size_manifest.py check` invocation — one baseline,
   one enforcement rule.
5. **Never-again**: the notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs in
   pages.yml (baselines never committed since #1096) are removed rather than
   armed — deploy-time gates are the wrong layer (this bug is the proof).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug, not a returned ticket).

{"content":"# gh-1684 RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Pages deploy red since #1631 merged — `build/fa-extension.zip` fails the
"Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)" with TOTAL-1P +230.3% (35.7 MB →
117.9 MB first-party): the six vendored on-device-engine rows
(`vendor/litert/0.12.1/*.wasm`, `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-*.wasm`,
`vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs`) are brand-new tracked lines far above the
5%-of-first-party-TOTAL NEW-line share.

**Root cause**: The vendored engines are *intentional* (gh-1630 CWS policy:
the extension must carry no remote code), but the size floor
(`scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv`) was never reseeded to the post-#1631
shape, and the only place the regression could surface was the **deploy-time**
gate in `pages.yml` — after merge. There was no PR-time gate on the extension
zip at all (gh-1684 decision 2).

**Impact**: Every Pages run since #1631 fails → fa1.dev deploys blocked;
the extension zip stayed on the pre-#1631 baseline channel.

**Why the release leg looked green (AC5 divergence)**: the build-macos
extension gate was *also* red (same baseline, same 6 lines — see issue #1262's
sibling history and the absent `fa-extension.zip` in the v1.0.600 release
assets). The release *object* still went out with assets because the release
is created at tag-cut (`ci.yml` → `auto_release.sh`) and populated by sibling
jobs that never need the extension job (`release-macos` needs only
`[version, build-macos]`; the CLI and web-spa legs attach their assets
race-safe with `gh release create || true`). So a red extension job never
reddened the release. Additionally the two build legs were not even
build-identical: `pages.yml` pins Flutter `3.47.7` exactly while
`build-macos.yml` build-extension used unpinned `channel: stable`.

**Fix approach** (owner direction 2026-10-18, locked):

1. **Download channel**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GH Releases
   (`releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`). Site links switch
   (`site/index.html` ×5 href/text occurrences incl. the JSON-LD answer,
   `site/llms.txt` ×2). Pages stops building/copying/gating the zip.
2. **Gate moves to PR review time**: new `extension-size-gate` job in `ci.yml`
   builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7 — release-identical) on
   PRs/dispatches whose diff can move the zip, and fails the PR against the
   committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate`.
3. **Reseed** `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape
   (built locally with the pinned SDK, `--reseed`).
4. **Symmetry**: `build-macos.yml` build-extension pins Flutter 3.47.7
   (exactly like pages.yml did); both legs gate against the same committed
   baseline with the same `size_manifest.py check` invocation — one baseline,
   one enforcement rule.
5. **Never-again**: the notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs in
   pages.yml (baselines never committed since #1096) are removed rather than
   armed — deploy-time gates are the wrong layer (this bug is the proof).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug, not a returned ticket).

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BUILD_ID: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Bust the Flutter demo app's entry scripts so browsers never load a
          # stale flutter_bootstrap.js / helper bundle after a new deploy.
          sed -i -E 's|src="([^\"]+)"|src="\1?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/app/index.html
          # Bust the landing page's own CSS/JS and the demo-app iframe/link.
          sed -i -E 's|href="styles\.css"|href="styles.css?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
        run: |
          # Per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget per line (issue
          # inventory format). First run seeds web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv
          # in the workspace (--init-if-missing) — the step below uploads
          # them as a ride-along artifact; commit them to arm the web
          # gates. The extension zip is gated against the committed
          # cut-shape baseline (same file the release gate in
          # build-macos.yml uses).
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/app \
            --baseline scripts/size_budget/web-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          if [ -d build/pages/root/outlook/app ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/root/outlook/app \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/outlook-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          fi
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv
          fi

      # The self-seeded baselines live only in this runner's workspace —
      # upload them so "commit it to arm the gate" is actually recoverable
      # (grab the artifact, commit the two TSVs).
      - name: Upload seeded size baselines (#1096 ratchet)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: size-baselines
          path: scripts/size_budget/*.tsv
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9 # v5.0.0

          path: build/pages/root

      # Gate the deploy on a real-browser boot smoke: serve the assembled
      # artifact and drive headless Chromium — the app must mount and run
      # Dart main() with zero console errors. Dart tests cannot catch
      # runtime JS-interop crashes (once shipped: the extension probe threw
      # a null-check on every normal page); this can and did.
      - name: Web boot smoke (headless Chromium)
        working-directory: build/pages/root
        run: |
          python3 -m http.server 8788 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
          SERVER_PID=$!
          trap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

{"content":"# gh-1684 RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Pages deploy red since #1631 merged — `build/fa-extension.zip` fails the
"Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)" with TOTAL-1P +230.3% (35.7 MB →
117.9 MB first-party): the six vendored on-device-engine rows
(`vendor/litert/0.12.1/*.wasm`, `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-*.wasm`,
`vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs`) are brand-new tracked lines far above the
5%-of-first-party-TOTAL NEW-line share.

**Root cause**: The vendored engines are *intentional* (gh-1630 CWS policy:
the extension must carry no remote code), but the size floor
(`scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv`) was never reseeded to the post-#1631
shape, and the only place the regression could surface was the **deploy-time**
gate in `pages.yml` — after merge. There was no PR-time gate on the extension
zip at all (gh-1684 decision 2).

**Impact**: Every Pages run since #1631 fails → fa1.dev deploys blocked;
the extension zip stayed on the pre-#1631 baseline channel.

**Why the release leg looked green (AC5 divergence)**: the build-macos
extension gate was *also* red (same baseline, same 6 lines — see issue #1262's
sibling history and the absent `fa-extension.zip` in the v1.0.600 release
assets). The release *object* still went out with assets because the release
is created at tag-cut (`ci.yml` → `auto_release.sh`) and populated by sibling
jobs that never need the extension job (`release-macos` needs only
`[version, build-macos]`; the CLI and web-spa legs attach their assets
race-safe with `gh release create || true`). So a red extension job never
reddened the release. Additionally the two build legs were not even
build-identical: `pages.yml` pins Flutter `3.47.7` exactly while
`build-macos.yml` build-extension used unpinned `channel: stable`.

**Fix approach** (owner direction 2026-10-18, locked):

1. **Download channel**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GH Releases
   (`releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`). Site links switch
   (`site/index.html` ×5 href/text occurrences incl. the JSON-LD answer,
   `site/llms.txt` ×2). Pages stops building/copying/gating the zip.
2. **Gate moves to PR review time**: new `extension-size-gate` job in `ci.yml`
   builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7 — release-identical) on
   PRs/dispatches whose diff can move the zip, and fails the PR against the
   committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate`.
3. **Reseed** `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape
   (built locally with the pinned SDK, `--reseed`).
4. **Symmetry**: `build-macos.yml` build-extension pins Flutter 3.47.7
   (exactly like pages.yml did); both legs gate against the same committed
   baseline with the same `size_manifest.py check` invocation — one baseline,
   one enforcement rule.
5. **Never-again**: the notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs in
   pages.yml (baselines never committed since #1096) are removed rather than
   armed — deploy-time gates are the wrong layer (this bug is the proof).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug, not a returned ticket).

170:      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
193:      - name: Upload seeded size baselines (#1096 ratchet)

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BUILD_ID: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Bust the Flutter demo app's entry scripts so browsers never load a
          # stale flutter_bootstrap.js / helper bundle after a new deploy.
          sed -i -E 's|src="([^\"]+)"|src="\1?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/app/index.html
          # Bust the landing page's own CSS/JS and the demo-app iframe/link.
          sed -i -E 's|href="styles\.css"|href="styles.css?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
        run: |
          # Per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget per line (issue
          # inventory format). First run seeds web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv
          # in the workspace (--init-if-missing) — the step below uploads
          # them as a ride-along artifact; commit them to arm the web
          # gates. The extension zip is gated against the committed
          # cut-shape baseline (same file the release gate in
          # build-macos.yml uses).
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/app \
            --baseline scripts/size_budget/web-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          if [ -d build/pages/root/outlook/app ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/root/outlook/app \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/outlook-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          fi
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv
          fi

      # The self-seeded baselines live only in this runner's workspace —
      # upload them so "commit it to arm the gate" is actually recoverable
      # (grab the artifact, commit the two TSVs).
      - name: Upload seeded size baselines (#1096 ratchet)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: size-baselines
          path: scripts/size_budget/*.tsv
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9 # v5.0.0
        with:
          path: build/pages/root

      # Gate the deploy on a real-browser boot smoke: serve the assembled
      # artifact and drive headless Chromium — the app must mount and run
      # Dart main() with zero console errors. Dart tests cannot catch
      # runtime JS-interop crashes (once shipped: the extension probe threw
      # a null-check on every normal page); this can and did.
      - name: Web boot smoke (headless Chromium)
        working-directory: build/pages/root
        run: |
          python3 -m http.server 8788 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
          SERVER_PID=$!
          trap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

{"content":"# gh-1684 RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Pages deploy red since #1631 merged — `build/fa-extension.zip` fails the
"Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)" with TOTAL-1P +230.3% (35.7 MB →
117.9 MB first-party): the six vendored on-device-engine rows
(`vendor/litert/0.12.1/*.wasm`, `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-*.wasm`,
`vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs`) are brand-new tracked lines far above the
5%-of-first-party-TOTAL NEW-line share.

**Root cause**: The vendored engines are *intentional* (gh-1630 CWS policy:
the extension must carry no remote code), but the size floor
(`scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv`) was never reseeded to the post-#1631
shape, and the only place the regression could surface was the **deploy-time**
gate in `pages.yml` — after merge. There was no PR-time gate on the extension
zip at all (gh-1684 decision 2).

**Impact**: Every Pages run since #1631 fails → fa1.dev deploys blocked;
the extension zip stayed on the pre-#1631 baseline channel.

**Why the release leg looked green (AC5 divergence)**: the build-macos
extension gate was *also* red (same baseline, same 6 lines — see issue #1262's
sibling history and the absent `fa-extension.zip` in the v1.0.600 release
assets). The release *object* still went out with assets because the release
is created at tag-cut (`ci.yml` → `auto_release.sh`) and populated by sibling
jobs that never need the extension job (`release-macos` needs only
`[version, build-macos]`; the CLI and web-spa legs attach their assets
race-safe with `gh release create || true`). So a red extension job never
reddened the release. Additionally the two build legs were not even
build-identical: `pages.yml` pins Flutter `3.47.7` exactly while
`build-macos.yml` build-extension used unpinned `channel: stable`.

**Fix approach** (owner direction 2026-10-18, locked):

1. **Download channel**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GH Releases
   (`releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`). Site links switch
   (`site/index.html` ×5 href/text occurrences incl. the JSON-LD answer,
   `site/llms.txt` ×2). Pages stops building/copying/gating the zip.
2. **Gate moves to PR review time**: new `extension-size-gate` job in `ci.yml`
   builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7 — release-identical) on
   PRs/dispatches whose diff can move the zip, and fails the PR against the
   committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate`.
3. **Reseed** `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape
   (built locally with the pinned SDK, `--reseed`).
4. **Symmetry**: `build-macos.yml` build-extension pins Flutter 3.47.7
   (exactly like pages.yml did); both legs gate against the same committed
   baseline with the same `size_manifest.py check` invocation — one baseline,
   one enforcement rule.
5. **Never-again**: the notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs in
   pages.yml (baselines never committed since #1096) are removed rather than
   armed — deploy-time gates are the wrong layer (this bug is the proof).

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug, not a returned ticket).
