      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BUILD_ID: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Bust the Flutter demo app's entry scripts so browsers never load a
          # stale flutter_bootstrap.js / helper bundle after a new deploy.
          sed -i -E 's|src="([^\"]+)"|src="\1?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/app/index.html
          # Bust the landing page's own CSS/JS and the demo-app iframe/link.
          sed -i -E 's|href="styles\.css"|href="styles.css?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
        run: |
          # Per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget per line (issue
          # inventory format). First run seeds web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv
          # in the workspace (--init-if-missing) — the step below uploads
          # them as a ride-along artifact; commit them to arm the web
          # gates. The extension zip is gated against the committed
          # cut-shape baseline (same file the release gate in
          # build-macos.yml uses).
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/app \
            --baseline scripts/size_budget/web-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          if [ -d build/pages/root/outlook/app ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/root/outlook/app \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/outlook-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          fi
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv
          fi

      # The self-seeded baselines live only in this runner's workspace —
      # upload them so "commit it to arm the gate" is actually recoverable
      # (grab the artifact, commit the two TSVs).
      - name: Upload seeded size baselines (#1096 ratchet)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: size-baselines
          path: scripts/size_budget/*.tsv
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9 # v5.0.0
        with:
          path: build/pages/root

      # Gate the deploy on a real-browser boot smoke: serve the assembled
      # artifact and drive headless Chromium — the app must mount and run
      # Dart main() with zero console errors. Dart tests cannot catch
      # runtime JS-interop crashes (once shipped: the extension probe threw
      # a null-check on every normal page); this can and did.
      - name: Web boot smoke (headless Chromium)
        working-directory: build/pages/root
        run: |
          python3 -m http.server 8788 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
          SERVER_PID=$!
          trap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

   runs-on: ubuntu-latest
   needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]

     (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
     needs.changes.outputs.extsize == 'true' &&

blocks.text:
Now add the new job. Place it right after the office-addin-suite job (which ends with "Upload assembled add-in" step before `app-crap-gate`). The app-crap-gate comment starts with " # Issue #433:". Insert the new job between.

Job definition:

```yaml
 # gh-1684 AC3: the fa-extension.zip size budget gate runs at PR review
 # time — the Pages deploy went red for days because #1631's intentional
 # vendor growth only surfaced in the DEPLOY leg, after merge. Any diff
 # that can move the zip builds it here, exactly like the release leg
 # (build_browser_ext.sh --with-app, Flutter 3.47.7 — the same exact
 # patch pin pages.yml carried, #1431) and fails the PR against the
 # committed baseline: a vendor-bump PR without a committed reseed goes
 # red HERE, at review time, not at deployment. Skipped legs pass (same
 # contract as office-addin-suite); tags/schedule are gated by the
 # release leg in build-macos.yml instead.
 extension-size-gate:
   name: Extension size gate (fa-extension.zip)
   runs-on: ubuntu-latest
   needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
   if: >-
     (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
     needs.changes.outputs.extsize == 'true' &&
     needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
   # dart2js agent (~1m) + flutter web release build (~4m) + vendor
   # fetch (~1m): same shape as the pages.yml extension step it
   # replaces, well under the office-addin-suite 45m ceiling.
   timeout-minutes: 30
   permissions:
     contents: read
   steps:
     - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

     - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b19624ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
       with:
         # gh-1684 AC5: the SAME exact patch pin as every other
         # fa-extension.zip leg (#1431 — a wildcard pin re-resolves a
         # new engine build per patch drop and moves the canvaskit rev
         # dir; the gate normalizes the rev, the pin keeps the builds
         # comparable across legs).
         flutter-version: '3.47.7'
         channel: stable

     - name: dart pub get (root + browser_ext/dart)
       run: |
         dart pub get
         cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

     # Full artifact, release-identical: SW agent (dart2js) + the
     # Flutter panel app embedded + the vendor.lock.json engines.
     - name: Build extension zip
       run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

     # One baseline, one enforcement rule — the identical invocation
     # the build-macos.yml release leg runs.
     - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1, gh-1684 AC3)
       run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv
```

   name: Extension size gate (fa-extension.zip)
   runs-on: ubuntu-latest
   needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]

     (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
     needs.changes.outputs.extsize == 'true' &&
     needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'

   name: Extension size gate (fa-extension.zip)
   runs-on: ubuntu-latest
   needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
   if: >-
     (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
     needs.changes.outputs.extsize == 'true' &&
     needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'

Now add the new job. Place it right after the office-addin-suite job (which ends with "Upload assembled add-in" step before `app-crap-gate`). The app-crap-gate comment starts with " # Issue #433:". Insert the new job between.

Job definition:

```yaml
 # gh-1684 AC3: the fa-extension.zip size budget gate runs at PR review
 # time — the Pages deploy went red for days because #1631's intentional
 # vendor growth only surfaced in the DEPLOY leg, after merge. Any diff
 # that can move the zip builds it here, exactly like the release leg
 # (build_browser_ext.sh --with-app, Flutter 3.47.7 — the same exact
 # patch pin pages.yml carried, #1431) and fails the PR against the
 # committed baseline: a vendor-bump PR without a committed reseed goes
 # red HERE, at review time, not at deployment. Skipped legs pass (same
 # contract as office-addin-suite); tags/schedule are gated by the
 # release leg in build-macos.yml instead.
 extension-size-gate:
   name: Extension size gate (fa-extension.zip)
   runs-on: ubuntu-latest
   needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
   if: >-
     (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
     needs.changes.outputs.extsize == 'true' &&
     needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
   # dart2js agent (~1m) + flutter web release build (~4m) + vendor
   # fetch (~1m): same shape as the pages.yml extension step it
   # replaces, well under the office-addin-suite 45m ceiling.
   timeout-minutes: 30
   permissions:
     contents: read
   steps:
     - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

     - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b19624ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
       with:
         # gh-1684 AC5: the SAME exact patch pin as every other
         # fa-extension.zip leg (#1431 — a wildcard pin re-resolves a
         # new engine build per patch drop and moves the canvaskit rev
         # dir; the gate normalizes the rev, the pin keeps the builds
         # comparable across legs).
         flutter-version: '3.47.7'
         channel: stable

     - name: dart pub get (root + browser_ext/dart)
       run: |
         dart pub get
         cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

     # Full artifact, release-identical: SW agent (dart2js) + the
     # Flutter panel app embedded + the vendor.lock.json engines.
     - name: Build extension zip
       run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

     # One baseline, one enforcement rule — the identical invocation
     # the build-macos.yml release leg runs.
     - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1, gh-1684 AC3)
       run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv
```

 # gh-1684 AC3: the fa-extension.zip size budget gate runs at PR review
 # time — the Pages deploy went red for days because #1631's intentional
 # vendor growth only surfaced in the DEPLOY leg, after merge. Any diff
 # that can move the zip builds it here, exactly like the release leg

 # committed baseline: a vendor-bump PR without a committed reseed goes
 # red HERE, at review time, not at deployment. Skipped legs pass (same
 # contract as office-addin-suite); tags/schedule are gated by the
 # release leg in build-macos.yml instead.
 extension-size-gate:
   name: Extension size gate (fa-extension.zip)
   runs-on: ubuntu-latest
   needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
   if: >-
     (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
     needs.changes.outputs.extsize == 'true' &&
     needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
   # dart2js agent (~1m) + flutter web release build (~4m) + vendor
   # fetch (~1m): same shape as the pages.yml extension step it
   # replaces, well under the office-addin-suite 45m ceiling.
   timeout-minutes: 30
   permissions:
     contents: read
   steps:
     - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

         # comparable across legs).

     - name: dart pub get (root + browser_ext/dart)

         dart pub get

     - name: Build extension zip

     - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1, gh-1684 AC3)

Now add the new job. Place it right after the office-addin-suite job (which ends with "Upload assembled add-in" step before `app-crap-gate`). The app-crap-gate comment starts with " # Issue #433:". Insert the new job between.

Job definition:

```yaml
 # gh-1684 AC3: the fa-extension.zip size budget gate runs at PR review
 # time — the Pages deploy went red for days because #1631's intentional
 # vendor growth only surfaced in the DEPLOY leg, after merge. Any diff
 # that can move the zip builds it here, exactly like the release leg
 # (build_browser_ext.sh --with-app, Flutter 3.47.7 — the same exact
 # patch pin pages.yml carried, #1431) and fails the PR against the
 # committed baseline: a vendor-bump PR without a committed reseed goes
 # red HERE, at review time, not at deployment. Skipped legs pass (same
 # contract as office-addin-suite); tags/schedule are gated by the
 # release leg in build-macos.yml instead.
 extension-size-gate:
   name: Extension size gate (fa-extension.zip)
   runs-on: ubuntu-latest
   needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
   if: >-
     (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
     needs.changes.outputs.extsize == 'true' &&
     needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
   # dart2js agent (~1m) + flutter web release build (~4m) + vendor
   # fetch (~1m): same shape as the pages.yml extension step it
   # replaces, well under the office-addin-suite 45m ceiling.
   timeout-minutes: 30
   permissions:
     contents: read
   steps:
     - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

     - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b19624ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
       with:
         # gh-1684 AC5: the SAME exact patch pin as every other
         # fa-extension.zip leg (#1431 — a wildcard pin re-resolves a
         # new engine build per patch drop and moves the canvaskit rev
         # dir; the gate normalizes the rev, the pin keeps the builds
         # comparable across legs).
         flutter-version: '3.47.7'
         channel: stable

     - name: dart pub get (root + browser_ext/dart)
       run: |
         dart pub get
         cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

     # Full artifact, release-identical: SW agent (dart2js) + the
     # Flutter panel app embedded + the vendor.lock.json engines.
     - name: Build extension zip
       run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

     # One baseline, one enforcement rule — the identical invocation
     # the build-macos.yml release leg runs.
     - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1, gh-1684 AC3)
       run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv
```

   name: Extension size gate (fa-extension.zip)
   runs-on: ubuntu-latest
   needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
   if: >-
     (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
     needs.changes.outputs.extsize == 'true' &&
     needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'

   # replaces, well under the office-addin-suite 45m ceiling.
   timeout-minutes: 30

     - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1, gh-1684 AC3)

Job definition:

```yaml
 # gh-1684 AC3: the fa-extension.zip size budget gate runs at PR review
 # time — the Pages deploy went red for days because #1631's intentional
 # vendor growth only surfaced in the DEPLOY leg, after merge. Any diff
 # that can move the zip builds it here, exactly like the release leg
 # (build_browser_ext.sh --with-app, Flutter 3.47.7 — the same exact
 # patch pin pages.yml carried, #1431) and fails the PR against the
 # committed baseline: a vendor-bump PR without a committed reseed goes
 # red HERE, at review time, not at deployment. Skipped legs pass (same
 # contract as office-addin-suite); tags/schedule are gated by the
 # release leg in build-macos.yml instead.
 extension-size-gate:
   name: Extension size gate (fa-extension.zip)
   runs-on: ubuntu-latest
   needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
   if: >-
     (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
     needs.changes.outputs.extsize == 'true' &&
     needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
   # dart2js agent (~1m) + flutter web release build (~4m) + vendor
   # fetch (~1m): same shape as the pages.yml extension step it
   # replaces, well under the office-addin-suite 45m ceiling.
   timeout-minutes: 30
   permissions:
     contents: read
   steps:
     - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

     - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b19624ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
       with:
         # gh-1684 AC5: the SAME exact patch pin as every other
         # fa-extension.zip leg (#1431 — a wildcard pin re-resolves a
         # new engine build per patch drop and moves the canvaskit rev
         # dir; the gate normalizes the rev, the pin keeps the builds
         # comparable across legs).
         flutter-version: '3.47.7'
         channel: stable

     - name: dart pub get (root + browser_ext/dart)
       run: |
         dart pub get
         cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get

     # Full artifact, release-identical: SW agent (dart2js) + the
     # Flutter panel app embedded + the vendor.lock.json engines.
     - name: Build extension zip
       run: bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

     # One baseline, one enforcement rule — the identical invocation
     # the build-macos.yml release leg runs.
     - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1, gh-1684 AC3)
       run: python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/fa-extension.zip --baseline scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv
```

arguments.content:
## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.

{"content":"## gh-1684 — Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631

### Root Cause
- #1631's vendored on-device engines (litert/transformers/webllm) are intentional (gh-1630 CWS no-remote-code policy), but the size floor was never reseeded and the only gate was deploy-time in `pages.yml` — the regression surfaced after merge and blocked Pages (run 39116173117: `TOTAL-1P +230.3%`, 6 lines beyond +5.0%).

### Fix
- **Download channel (AC1/AC2)**: `fa-extension.zip` moves to GitHub Releases. `site/index.html` (5 link/text occurrences incl. the FAQ JSON-LD) + `site/llms.txt` (×2) now point at `releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip`; the per-release JS rewrite is gone (static href IS the release). `pages.yml` no longer builds/copies/gates the zip; `build-macos.yml` build-extension keeps attaching it to releases (gate-before-upload).
- **Gate at review time (AC3)**: new `extension-size-gate` leg in `ci.yml` — builds the real zip (`--with-app`, Flutter 3.47.7) on extension/app/core/vendor/baseline/workflow-touching PRs + SM validation dispatches, fails the PR against the committed baseline; wired into `quality-gate` (platform class, skipped = pass). A vendor-bump PR without a reseed goes red at review.
- **Reseed (decision 3)**: `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` reseeded to the post-#1631 shape (42 rows, TOTAL 155,539,998) from a zip built with the pinned SDK.
- **Never-again (AC4)**: notice-only `web-app.tsv`/`outlook-app.tsv` legs (baselines never committed since #1096) removed from Pages rather than armed.
- **Symmetry (AC5)**: release leg + PR leg + (retired Pages leg) share one baseline, one `size_manifest.py check` invocation, one Flutter 3.47.7 pin — build-macos's old unpinned `channel: stable` pinned.

### macos/PR gate symmetry — why releases looked green (AC5)
The release extension gate was red too (same 6 lines; `fa-extension.zip` absent from v1.0.600 assets). The release *object* still shipped because the tag-cut (`auto_release.sh`) creates it and sibling jobs attach assets without needing the extension job (`release-macos` needs only `[version, build-macos]`; CLI/web-spa legs race-safe `gh release create || true`). Fixed structurally: the PR gate now catches regressions before merge, so the release leg can't be the first alarm.

### Test Coverage
- RED repro: gate vs old baseline fails with the exact ticket signature (+230.3%, 6 lines, 73.3→155.5MB raw). GREEN: reseeded baseline passes (+0.0%); `size_manifest.py selftest` PASS; `scripts/test_size_manifest.py` OK.
- New wiring guard `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17 tests); legacy guards (ci_1267, ci_1659, pub-get-retry, dispatch-watch, site llms/appstore, browser_ext shape) updated + green — 125 tests.

### Notes
- AC4 chose **remove** over arm (owner decision allows either): deploy-time gates are the wrong layer, and a baseline generated from a differently-flagged build would false-red.
- Pages trigger paths dropped `browser_ext/**` (nothing extension-related deploys anymore); website-leg watch budget (60m worst-case) only shrinks.
- Full `dart test` suite result is reported by CI; the touched suites above pass locally.
